jobs.title: Staff Product Manager (Customer Agent Team)
jobs.description:
Fin, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.

Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.

Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.

Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

We’re looking for a Staff Product Manager to join our team and help shape the future of business messaging and AI-powered customer engagement. This is a career-defining opportunity to lead a world-class team of engineers, designers, and researchers to deliver products that touch millions of people every day.

What will I be doing?

  • Be responsible for a significant product area or leading an important project.
  • Deeply understand the customer problems you’re tackling through research, data, and direct customer interactions — then frame those problems clearly for your team.
  • Manage the roadmap; defining what should be built, when and why - and communicate it to generate alignment and excitement. 
  • Collaborate with engineers and designers to imagine, build, and ship solutions, from bold future visions to small, focused iterations.
  • Leverage AI to increase your own efficiency, accelerate product development, and multiply your team’s impact. 
  • Evaluate impact through quantitative and qualitative measures, both in beta and after full release.
  • Own and maintain the quality of your product area, ensuring every release delivers world-class software.
  • Collaborate with peers across the business to ensure we deliver products with clear GTM strategy and execution, getting hands on wherever necessary to ensure we deliver.

Outsight’s software solutions track the motion of people and vehicles using 3D LiDAR data.

 Operators of transportation hubs like airports and train stations but also sport venues, road infrastructures and industrial sites can now access accurate and anonymous Spatial Intelligence data, in order to improve operations and increase user safety and satisfaction.

 

 Our international team of scientists and engineers drive the development of our solutions from Paris, San Francisco, Sophia-Antipolis (Nice) & Hong Kong. To support our global outreach, we also operate a commercial office in Spain.

 

 You can find below an interesting link about who we are and what we do :

 Insights about Outsight 

 

 Our Passenger Flow Traffic Monitoring solution is trusted by the world’s leading airports and train stations across four continents, including the most renowned hubs celebrated for their operational excellence and exceptional passenger experience. We also deploy our solutions in other markets such as Tourism, Retail and Sports.

 Additionally, our Car Traffic Remote Monitoring product is trusted by several Tier 1 customers, including BMW.

 

 Our Hybrid SaaS platform, SHIFT , turns raw data from Lidars and Edge AI appliances into actionable real-time insights—from optimizing passenger flow at international airports to ensuring safety in industrial zones. We operate a complex infrastructure spanning on-premise Edge devices, cloud backends, and end-user interfaces. 

 

 

 The Mission: Finding the Next "Airport" 

 

 Our core technology (Spatial Intelligence) is powerful, but we have only scratched the surface of its potential. Your mission is to explore Adjacent Markets to find our next major revenue stream. 

 

 You will act as a "Startup Founder" within Outsight. You will investigate verticals like Physical Security (Intrusion Detection), Retail (Shopping Paths), and Smart Buildings to answer two questions: Can we solve their problem? and will they pay for it? 

 

 Responsibilities 

 

 Market discovery: Get out of the building. You will interview potential buyers in new sectors to understand their pain points. You will map the competitive landscape (e.g., "Why would a Mall buy Lidar instead of cheap cameras?"). Hypothesis testing: Design experiments to validate willingness-to-pay in new markets. 

 

 MVP definition & prototyping: Leverage our existing Platform to configure "Vertical MVPs." You won't ask engineering to build a whole new product for 6 months; you will hack together a solution to test a hypothesis with a design partner in 4 weeks. 

 

 Go-to-Market Strategy: A Security Director buys differently than an Airport Manager. You will define the Packaging, Pricing, and Positioning for these new offers. 

 

 Pilot Management: Oversee the first deployments in these new sectors, acting as both PM and temporary Solution Engineer to ensure the first customers succeed. 

 

 Go/No-Go Decisions: You own the business case. You must be brave enough to kill a project if the market isn't there, or pitch for resources to double down if it is. 

 

 What are the requirements for the role? 

 

 5+ years in Product Management , ideally in an early-stage startup or an Innovation Lab environment. 

 

 Commercially Minded: You understand that a product is only successful if it can be sold. You are comfortable discussing ROI and budgets. 

 

 The "Zero to One" Mindset: You are comfortable with ambiguity. You don't need a polished roadmap; you need a problem to solve. 

 

 Tech-Savvy: You can understand the capabilities of our Lidar platform well enough to know what can be "configured" quickly for a demo vs. what requires deep engineering. 

 

 Why join us? 

 

 As a 7-time Gartner-recognized category-defining leader with dozens of global awards including “Edge AI Product of the Year,” “LiDAR Leader Award,” “CES Best of Innovation” and many more, we’re backed by 37 patents and deployments with the most prestigious (and challenging) customers across four continents. 

 

 Join our international team of world-class experienced engineers and business leaders solving humanity’s most complex spatial challenges, from passenger flow optimization to autonomous robotics coordination, while working at the cutting edge of 3D AI, LiDAR perception, and real-time analytics. 

 

 Supported by rock-solid investors including BNP Paribas, BPI France, Energy Innovation Capital and Demeter who back our long-term vision, this is your opportunity to shape how physical and digital worlds interact, with the resources, growth trajectory, and technical challenges that will accelerate your career in ways traditional companies cannot offer.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Fulfilment
jobs.description:
About Nivoda
 Nivoda is the operating system for the global jewellery industry. Our marketplace connects jewellers with suppliers of diamonds, gemstones, melee and finished jewellery in 70+ countries, with more than $300M in annual transactions and a $350B industry still waiting to be modernised. We are scaling fast, and we are only getting started.

 Our Mission
 For decades, the diamond trade has been slow, opaque and inefficient: hard to find stock, hard to trust prices, hard to know when anything will arrive. Nivoda exists to change that. We give businesses of every size, in every location, the same access to inventory, the same transparent pricing and the same reliable delivery as the biggest players in the industry.

 The Fulfilment & Express Team
 The Fulfilment & Express team is where Nivoda's promise to buyers is kept. We own how an order travels from supplier to jeweller: the delivery date we promise, the hubs that hold and check stock, the carriers that move it, and the returns and quality checks that protect every purchase. We are a remote-first team of product, engineering, design and QA who work closely with Operations, Customer Support, Sales and Supplier Experience. We are low on hierarchy and high on ownership, and we like solving problems where software meets the physical world.

 About the Role
 As our Senior Product Manager for Fulfilment & Express, you will own how Nivoda orders get from supplier to jeweller: accurately promised, reliably tracked and delivered fast. You will set the strategy and roadmap for a complex, operationally heavy product area that spans diamonds, gemstones, melee and finished jewellery, with physical hubs, carriers and suppliers behind every screen. Your work decides whether a jeweller trusts Nivoda with their next order, so this is a role with real commercial impact and plenty of room to lead.

 What would YOU be doing?
 Setting the fulfilment strategy for the next 2 to 4 quarters, making trade-offs explicit, including what we are choosing not to do and why

 Owning the roadmap and the numbers: running quarterly planning, sizing opportunities and setting targets for delivery-as-promised, delivery date accuracy and delivery speed

 Making our Promised Delivery Dates trustworthy by rolling out SLA-based, dynamic delivery dates across every category and route, and shaping how they are used for delay communications and, in time, shown to buyers

 Scaling Express, our hub-based fast-delivery offer, including hub workflows (receiving, inventory and RFID put/pick, QC and dispatch), ready-to-wear jewellery, consignment flows and speed options such as same-day pickup

 Owning jewellery returns and on-platform QC, from the manufacturer through to the hub, including hallmarking and consignment returns to suppliers

 Improving the delivery experience through carrier and rate/transit integrations, consolidation, last-mile cost and efficiency, and clear order visibility for buyers

 Translating hub operations, carrier behaviour, customs and supplier handling into clear product requirements, designing for the exceptions as much as the happy path

 Turning support tickets, delay breaches, supplier performance data and customer feedback into prioritised problems, then deciding what to build, buy or fix operationally

 Partnering daily with Engineering and Design, and closely with Operations, Customer Support, Account Management, Sales, Supplier Experience and Fintech so delivery, credit and payments feel like one journey for the buyer

 Writing sharp PRDs and decision records, and reporting progress openly through our weekly updates

 Mentoring other product managers and designers on working in operationally complex domains

 What do we need from YOU?
 5 to 8 years in product management, including experience owning a complex product area end to end

 Experience in fulfilment, logistics, supply chain or other operations-heavy products. You are comfortable where software meets warehouses, carriers, SLAs and customs

 Strong systems thinking: you can map a multi-party process, find where promises break, and design for failure modes, delays and edge cases

 Data fluency: you define the right metrics, query and interrogate data yourself (Snowflake, Mixpanel or similar) and use it to decide what to build next

 Sound prioritisation and commercial judgement: you weigh impact, effort and risk honestly, say no clearly, and can explain the return on a fulfilment investment to leadership

 Excellent cross-functional leadership: you build trust with engineers, operators and commercial teams, and influence without authority across time zones

 Clear written communication: concise PRDs, roadmaps and updates that make decisions easy

 Customer and operator empathy, and high agency: you spend time with jewellers, support teams and hub operators, you take ownership, and you follow things through to the outcome

 Jewellery, diamond or luxury goods experience

You'll write the positioning and run the first launches yourself, then grow the team around what works.
 Legal AI is noisy. Everyone's making similar claims, and buyers struggle to tell them apart. Underneath the noise is a huge opportunity: in-house legal is one of the last functions without a system built for how it works. That's a new category, and it's wide open. Your job is to define it: what it is, why it matters, and why Wordsmith is the platform in-house teams run on. If you've done that in a fast-moving market and want to build the function that does it, this role is for you.
 
 What you'll do 
 Own positioning and messaging. Take our positioning and turn it into the pitch across the sales deck, website and campaigns. Keep one messaging source of truth current as the product and market move.

 Get in before the build. Work with Product to define the narrative, the story and the value before teams start building, not when a feature is nearly ready to ship.

 Accelerate how we launch. Build a clear path from build to ship to launch: launch tiers, one owner for launch comms, and a calendar the business can plan around. Make launches drive adoption and pipeline, not just announcements.

 Know the buyer better than anyone. General Counsel, heads of legal, legal ops and the business teams they serve. Run win/loss, sit in on calls, talk to customers, and turn what you learn into sharper messaging and product input.

 Run competitive. Build the competitive program reps actually use: battlecards, objection handling and a clear point of view on every alternative a buyer is weighing.

 Equip Sales. Partner with GTM Enablement so reps can tell the story, handle the hard questions and sell the platform, including pricing and packaging changes as they roll out.

 Feed Growth. Give Growth, paid, lifecycle and ABM the messaging, offers and content they need to create pipeline globally.

 Build product marketing for the AI era. Use AI-enabled workflows to run win/loss at scale, synthesize call recordings, test messaging and keep enablement current, so a small team covers more ground.

 Build the team. Set the hiring bar, hire two product marketers in 2027, and shape how product marketing works alongside Product in an AI-native company.

 
 What we're looking for 
 You reason from first principles. You build positioning from what's true about our buyers and market, not from category templates, and you see how messaging, launches, enablement and growth work as one system.

 You've built and led product marketing at a B2B software company selling to mid-market and enterprise through a sales-led motion.

 You're a builder. You still like doing the work yourself and set the bar by example.

 Positioning work that changed how a company sells. You can point to the before and after.

 Sharp writing and a clear point of view. You can make a complex platform simple without making it generic.

 Commercial judgment. You tie your work to win rate, sales cycle and pipeline, not output.

 Strong cross-functional influence with Product, Sales and executives. You can push back and bring people with you.

 You're AI-forward and fluent in how AI products work. You can go deep with Product and Engineering on agents and models, then explain them to a General Counsel in plain language. You've already rebuilt parts of how you work with AI and can show us.

 
 It would also be great if you have: 
 Repositioned a product from point solution to platform.

 Pricing and packaging work.

 Go-to-market experience across both the US and UK or Europe.

 Scaled product marketing through Series B and beyond.

  
 How we'll measure success 
 Win rate and sales cycle in competitive deals

 Launches that

Our story:
 Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.

 Drive adoption and depth of engagement. Make this the product customers rely on all year, not once. Own activation, retention and how widely customers use what we offer.

 Build the AI-native product. Have a clear point of view on where AI removes real load for the self-employed and for accountants, and push the team to build what was not possible only months ago.

 Run the team on experimentation and data. Make decisions with data, and with strategy and market judgement when the data is unclear. Speed to learning is a first-class metric you own.

 Be the commercial partner, not the commercial owner. Shape the proposition with your commercial partner: tiers, pricing, packaging and bundling.  Build responsibly in a regulated space. Work with compliance, financial crime and tax experts so that what you ship meets regulatory standards and is accurate, explainable and safe, including the edge cases and the risks that come with AI.

 Set the bar for craft. Set direction for the teams you work with. Give them a vision sharp enough to act on and help remove handoffs and bottlenecks. Be entrepreneurial and lean in to build directly when needed. Credibility and influence matter more than authority.

 You have led product for a multi-team area, ideally for consumer or micro-SME customers, in a scale-up where you had fewer resources than you wanted and got things done by being hands-on.

 You have taken a product from early traction to a real growth engine, with customers who rely on it, not just sign-ups. You can say why it worked, which metric moved and what you would do differently.

 Experience in accounting, tax, or banking products is a strong plus, as is familiarity with UK tax, Making Tax Digital or HMRC-facing products.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager
jobs.description:
Unleash AI Innovators, Securely 
 Software is being rewritten in real time. AI agents are starting to write more code than humans do, at a speed no security team has ever had to match, and that single shift is opening up the biggest opportunity our industry has seen in a decade. We're not bracing for it, we're building the company that owns it.
 Snyk is building the next generation security platform where security isn't a set of tools people operate. It's a team of security agents working alongside your engineers, finding, fixing, and governing risk at the speed software is now built. These agents work alongside both the company build and the agents they adopt. Security stops being a queue of work waiting for people, and becomes a coordinated workforce companies direct and trust.
 Why this role? 
  
 As a Staff Product Manager in Snyk's Agent Security division, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping how modern organizations build and secure AI applications at scale. You'll join a collaborative, forward-thinking team and help drive our mission to embed security into every part of the AI-native development lifecycle. This is a unique opportunity to shape early-stage products from the ground up, operating with the agility of a startup while leveraging the scale of an industry leader.
 
 What You’ll Do 
 Lead new product discovery from idea to execution by partnering with engineers, designers, and customers to identify high-potential opportunities in AI security and beyond.

 Validate problem-solution fit by designing lean experiments and MVPs to quickly validate customer problems and solution approaches.

 Shape the vision and roadmap for the capabilities that you own, balancing short-term experiments with long-term strategic bets.

 Influence the broader innovation agenda by presenting roadmap and strategy to customers, leadership, and internal stakeholders.

 Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, design, and go-to-market teams to take new ideas from concept to product-market fit.

 
 What You Bring 
 You have solid experience in technology, with strong experience in a product management role.

 You bring a strong technical background and the ability to engage deeply with engineering and AI/ML concepts.

 You are comfortable with high ambiguity and can design frameworks to execute effectively in fast-moving, uncertain environments.

 You have a proven track record of taking early-stage products from concept to launch within SaaS or developer tooling.

 You have strong communication and storytelling skills to influence across teams, leadership, and customers.

 
 It’d Be Awesome If You Also… 
 Have hands-on experience in developer security, AI/ML products, or agentic systems.

 Contribute to open-source or developer communities.

 Have a background in software engineering or have worked in a startup or internal incubator environment.

 Love solving complex problems with a collaborative team.

 Bring fresh ideas and aren’t afraid to challenge the status quo.

 About Snyk 
 Snyk is committed to creating an inclusive and engaging environment where our employees can thrive as we rally behind our common mission to make the digital world a safer place. From Snyk employee resource groups, to global benefits that help our employees prioritize their health, wellness, financial security, and a work/life blend, we aim to support our employees along their entire journeys here at Snyk.
 
 Equal Employment Opportunity 
 Snyk is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

 Zu unseren langjährigen Kunden zählen unter anderem OTTO, R+V Versicherung, Allianz Trade und Suzuki.
 DIU ist geprägt von einer Kultur der Innovation und vom Anspruch, Technologie dort einzusetzen, wo sie messbar Wirkung erzeugt. Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der IT getreu unserem Motto: Unleash your power in IT.

 Aufgaben
 WANTED

Wir orchestrieren Systeme, Prozesse und KI-Services toolunabhängig. Wo keine passende Standardlösung existiert, bauen wir schlanke, eigene Lösungen und bewerten jede Entscheidung wirtschaftlich im Interesse unserer Kunden.

Bei uns sind die Wege kurz, Entscheidungen transparent und Zusammenarbeit professionell. Als Projektmanager (m/w/d) MarTech verantwortest du Projekte rund um Automatisierungslösungen, Marketing Production Automation (kurz: MPA) und die Integration von Systemen der Content Supply Chain. Kleinere Automatisierungen, Prototypen und Integrationen setzt du selbst um, zum Beispiel mit Claude Code, MCP-Servern oder Low-Code-Plattformen.

 DOINGS 
 Du planst, steuerst und setzt Projekte entlang der Content Supply Chain um: Automatisierungslösungen, MPA-Services und Systemintegrationen.

 Du analysierst Content-Prozesse bei unseren Kunden, identifizierst Automatisierungspotenziale und übersetzt Anforderungen in fachliche und technische Aufgaben.

 Du entwickelst einfache technische Lösungen selbst, etwa Workflow-Automatisierungen, Schnittstellen, Prototypen oder Self-Service-Tools, unterstützt durch KI-Werkzeuge wie Claude Code und MCPs.

 Du sorgst dafür, dass sich Lösungen reibungslos in bestehende MarTech-Landschaften und Prozesse einfügen.

 Du verantwortest Projektplanung, Zeitpläne, Budgets und Ressourcen für deine Projekte.

 Du bist Ansprechperson für Kunden, Fachbereiche und Entwicklung und sorgst für klare, regelmäßige Kommunikation.

 Du übernimmst die fachliche Leitung von Teilprojekten und unterstützt den Teamlead bei Planung, Priorisierung und Steuerung.

 Qualifikation

 Mehrjährige Projektmanagement-Erfahrung, bestenfalls in Projekten mit technischem Umsetzungscharakter.

 Hands-on-Mentalität: Du hast Freude daran, Lösungen selbst zu bauen, und hast erste Erfahrung mit Scripting, APIs oder Automatisierungsplattformen wie bspw. Make.

 Erfahrung mit KI-gestützter Entwicklung (z. B. Claude Code, MCP, LLM-APIs) oder große Lust, dich darin schnell einzuarbeiten.

 Verständnis für Content-Prozesse im Marketing sowie für IT-Architekturen, Datenflüsse und Schnittstellen, um mit Entwicklung und Kunden auf Augenhöhe zu sprechen.

 Erfahrung mit Systemen der Content Supply Chain (z. B. Marketing-Automation, DAM, Workflow- oder Produktionsplattformen) ist von Vorteil.

 Erfahrung in Projekten im Konzernumfeld und Sicherheit im Umgang mit vielen Beteiligten.

 Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

 Bei DIU besetzen wir nicht Stellen, sondern suchen nach Menschen mit Leidenschaft für ihr Fachgebiet. Wir verstehen uns als Plattform für ein Team aus Menschen, die ihre Leidenschaft mit anderen teilen oder in Projekte einbringen möchten. Den Rahmen für diese Arbeit schaffen wir mit:

 Einer agilen Unternehmensorganisation

jobs.title: Software Engineering Manager - Accounting Product
jobs.description:
[OUR MISSION AND CUSTOMERS] We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.7 on Trustpilot, based on 60,000 reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do (more about our culture here ). 
  
 [OUR JOURNEY] Founded in 2016 and launched in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve , Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.
  
 [OUR BELIEFS] We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, and 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.
  
 [AI AT QONTO] AI is deeply embedded in how we work ( here ) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.
 
 Join us as Engineering Manager – Accounting Product and help build the last missing piece of Qonto’s all-in-one offer for businesses. You’ll lead a cross-functional team of engineers making accounting effortless for business owners, under the guidance of Yanis, our Head of Engineering for the Accounting domain.
 
 ➡️ What you’ll do 
 Lead your team: You’ll manage engineers across the stack and help each of them grow.

 Put accounting on autopilot: You’ll build features that generate bookkeeping automatically and show customers, in real time, the VAT they owe.

 Make accounting simple: You’ll turn complex accounting and tax steps into a clear experience that business owners can complete with confidence.

 Bring AI into accounting: You’ll ship AI-first experiences, like a chat that answers customers from their own accounting file.

 Co-own the product: You’ll shape the roadmap with your Product Manager and Designer, from discovery to impact.

 Unblock your team technically: You’ll dive into design, code reviews and debugging with your engineers, whatever the stack.

 
 ➡️ What we’re looking for 
 People leadership: You’ve led engineers as a manager or Tech Lead, and you’re driven by helping people grow.

 Hands-on technical background: You’ve built production systems yourself and can help your team solve technical problems in any stack, using AI to get up to speed on languages you know less.

 AI-driven development: You use AI in your own engineering work and push your team to raise the bar with it.

 Languages: You’re fluent in English (French is a bonus).

 Bonus: You’re familiar with the French accounting world, its services and how accountants work with businesses.

 
 ➡️ What we can offer you 
 A product at launch: You’ll join right after the first launch of Qonto Accounting and shape what it becomes.

 Visible business impact: Accounting keeps customers with Qonto for the long run, so your team’s work shows up directly in loyalty.

 A domain on the move: Qonto Accounting is growing fast in France and starting to expand to other European markets.

 
 ➡️ Your future manager 
 You’ll report to Yanis , Head of Engineering, but don’t expect micro-management. Yanis grew from Lead Engineer to Head of Engineering over 4 years at Qonto. He’s a pragmatic generalist who has built payment integrations from scratch and is as comfortable on the frontend as on the backend. He gives engineers real ownership, values sharing failures as much as wins, and gets out of the way so the team can ship.
 
 ➡️ Our stack & practices 
 Our primary languages are Go and Ruby , React for frontend, and Kotlin and Swift for our mobile apps. 

 Our platform runs on Kubernetes , hosted on AWS , with PostgreSQL as our database of choice.

 We use Kafka for event-driven architecture and ELK for logging and auditing, among many other tools.

 Each engineer gets access to AI-first tooling ( Claude Code , Cursor , Notion AI ), and we want people who use AI to raise the bar, not just to go faster. Read our AI vision statement .

 We use Linear as an issue tracking and project management platform for our software development.

 
 ➡️ Our methodology: the Qonto Way 
 We value upfront technical design, team code reviews, and smart slicing — quality drives the velocity our customers need.

 Our lean toolbox, Kaizen and PDCA, lets you drive continuous improvement with your peers and manager.

 Want to go further? Read about the Qonto Way .

 
 ➡️ About our hiring process 
 2 interviews (1 hour each): first with your Talent Acquisition Manager, then with Yanis, your future direct manager.

 Live skill test (about 2 hours) with two engineers: product discussion, system design and an AI-assisted code review.

 Final interview (1 hour): with Carl, our VP Engineering.

 
 [DIVERSITY] At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes

jobs.title: Plattform Project Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Starte bei Symporo durch und unterstütze uns dabei, Daten in aussagekräftige Reports und Dashboards zu verwandeln.

 Worum es geht 

Die Symporo Gruppe vereint 13 regionale Catering-Marken mit über 1.400 Mitarbeitenden an acht Standorten. Jeden Tag bereiten wir mehr als 100.000 Mahlzeiten für Kitas, Schulen, Senioren und Unternehmen zu. Jede Marke arbeitet heute mit eigenen Systemen, Webseiten und Abläufen.

Deshalb bauen wir eine eigene, gemeinsame Plattform für die ganze Gruppe. Sie reicht vom Webshop, über den Eltern, Schulen und Senioren bestellen, über Speisepläne, Rezepte und Küche bis zu Einkauf, Lager und Lieferung. Ein erfahrenes, internationales Entwicklungsteam setzt die Plattform um. Das Projekt läuft über mehr als zwei Jahre, und wir führen es Unternehmen für Unternehmen ein. Ein großer Teil der Arbeit liegt in der Veränderung der täglichen Abläufe. Die Gruppe wächst weiter, und jedes neue Unternehmen kommt ebenfalls auf die Plattform.

Wir suchen die Person, die dieses Projekt im Alltag zusammenhält: zwischen unseren Unternehmen und dem Entwicklungsteam.

 Deine Aufgaben 

 Du planst und steuerst die Einführung der Plattform in unseren Unternehmen: Zeitpläne, Aufgaben, Abhängigkeiten und offene Punkte.
 Du bist die Brücke zwischen unseren Unternehmen und dem Entwicklungsteam und trägst Verantwortung auf beiden Seiten.
 Auf Seiten der Unternehmen lernst du die Abläufe in unseren Küchen, in der Bestellannahme, Tourenplanung und Buchhaltung kennen. Du sprichst mit den Teams vor Ort auf Deutsch und übersetzt das Gelernte in klare Produktanforderungen. Du begleitest jedes Team durch die Veränderung im Arbeitsalltag, damit die neuen Abläufe nach dem Start Bestand haben.
 Auf Seiten der Entwicklung arbeitest du täglich auf Englisch mit dem Team: Du priorisierst das Backlog, beantwortest Rückfragen schnell, erklärst, wie unser Betrieb funktioniert, und nimmst neue Funktionen ab.
 Du organisierst Tests mit den Teams vor Ort, die Übernahme von Daten (Kunden, Speisepläne, Preise) und Schulungen. Du schulst Key User, die danach ihre Kolleginnen und Kollegen unterstützen.
 Rund um jeden Start und während der Schulungen bist du länger vor Ort. Reisen innerhalb Deutschlands sind ein großer Teil dieser Rolle.
 Du stimmst jeden Start mit unserem E-Commerce & Content Specialist ab: Inhalte der Webseite, Zeitpunkt des Starts und Kommunikation an unsere Kunden.
 Du bringst neu hinzugekommene Unternehmen auf die Plattform.
 Du hältst Geschäftsführungen und Lenkungskreis auf dem Laufenden: Fortschritt, Risiken und anstehende Entscheidungen.
 Du dokumentierst Abläufe, Entscheidungen und Anleitungen so, dass andere damit arbeiten können.
 

 Das bringst du mit 

 3 bis 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Projektmanagement, idealerweise an der Schnittstelle zwischen Betrieb und IT.
 Idealerweise Erfahrung in Hotellerie, Gastronomie, Catering oder Lebensmittelproduktion. Eine Ausbildung oder Erfahrung in der Küche ist ein klarer Pluspunkt.
 Erfahrung darin, neue Systeme oder Abläufe in operativen Teams einzuführen.
 Grundwissen im IT-Produktmanagement: Du weißt, was eine User Story, ein Release und ein Test sind, und hast mit Jira, Azure DevOps oder ähnlichen Tools gearbeitet.
 Du sprichst mit einem Koch in der Küche genauso sicher wie mit einem Entwickler im Videocall.
 Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift. Du arbeitest jeden Tag in beiden Sprachen: auf Deutsch mit unseren Unternehmen, auf Englisch mit dem Entwicklungsteam.
 Du bleibst ruhig und strukturiert, wenn viele Themen gleichzeitig laufen, und bringst Dinge zu Ende.
 Du nutzt KI-Tools wie ChatGPT oder Claude selbstverständlich im Arbeitsalltag.
 Erfahrung mit Daten und Reporting, zum Beispiel in Excel oder SQL, ist ein Plus.

jobs.title: Product Lead - Geförderte Weiterbildung (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Jedes Team hat KI. Nur wenige haben sie gemeistert. Wir Menschen sind gemacht, uns anzupassen. Aber KI entwickelt sich so rasant, dass die meisten Belegschaften kaum noch Schritt halten.

 Als Teil von Multiverse ist StackFuel Deutschlands führender Anbieter für Daten- und KI-Weiterbildung. 2017 in Berlin gegründet, haben wir bereits über 8.000 Absolvent:innen weitergebildet, mit einer Abschlussquote von über 90 % bei Unternehmen wie der Deutschen Bahn, Mercedes-Benz und Telefónica.

 Seit 2026 gehören wir zu Multiverse und bauen gemeinsam den KI-Adoption-Layer für Europa auf: das fehlende Bindeglied zwischen den KI-Tools, in die Unternehmen investiert haben, und den Menschen, die sie im Arbeitsalltag nutzen sollen. Multiverse hat im April 2026 seine jüngste Finanzierungsrunde abgeschlossen und wird mit 2,1 Mrd. US-Dollar bewertet. Insgesamt haben wir über 500 Mio. US-Dollar von Investoren wie Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Schroders Capital und Lightspeed eingesammelt.

 Wir wollen 100.000 Beschäftigte in Deutschland für das KI-Zeitalter weiterbilden: mit einem Team, das den deutschen Markt kennt, und einem starken Partner im Rücken, der uns Tempo ermöglicht.

 Du willst mitgestalten, wie Deutschlands Arbeitswelt im KI-Zeitalter erfolgreich wird? Dann komm zu uns.
 
 Darum geht's 
 
 Der Arbeitsmarkt braucht KI-Kompetenz, und viele Menschen könnten sie lernen, wenn der Weg dorthin gefördert wird. Genau dort setzt du an. Als Lead Geförderte Weiterbildung baust du unser Angebot für Privatpersonen auf, die ihre Weiterbildung mit einem Bildungsgutschein der Agentur für Arbeit oder des Jobcenters finanzieren. Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere KI- und Data-Programme AZAV-konform zugelassen sind, bei den Arbeitsagenturen überzeugen und Teilnehmende in einen echten Berufseinstieg oder Karrieresprung führen.

Eng zusammen arbeitest du mit Learning Content Engineers, Sales, Marketing, Legal und der Geschäftsführung. Du verstehst die Logik des Fördersystems und übersetzt sie in Programme, die didaktisch überzeugen und sich wirtschaftlich tragen.
 
 Das gestaltest du 
 
 Du leitest die Zulassung und Re-Zertifizierung unserer Maßnahmen nach AZAV, gemeinsam mit der fachkundigen Stelle.

 Du entwickelst förderfähige KI- und Data-Programme, die zu Kostensätzen, Dauer und Arbeitsmarktbedarf passen.

 Du baust und pflegst die Zusammenarbeit mit Agenturen für Arbeit, Jobcentern und weiteren Förderstellen, damit unsere Maßnahmen in der Beratung bekannt sind und passend empfohlen werden.

 Du gestaltest den Weg der Teilnehmenden von der Beratung bei der Arbeitsagentur über die Gutscheineinlösung bis zum Start und Abschluss der Maßnahme.

 Du sorgst für saubere Prozesse bei Teilnahmedokumentation, Abrechnung mit den Kostenträgern und Nachweisen.

 Du arbeitest mit Learning Content Engineers daran, Curricula, Prüfungen und Zertifikate an den Anforderungen der Förderung auszurichten.

 Du arbeitest mit Sales und Marketing an Ansprache und Information für Interessent:innen, die mit Bildungsgutschein starten wollen.

 Du verfolgst Vermittlungs- und Verbleibsquoten, Abbruchquoten, Teilnehmerfeedback und Änderungen im Förderrecht und leitest daraus Verbesserungen ab.

 Du führst ein kleines Team oder koordinierst Kolleg:innen und externe Partner fachlich.

 Ein abgeschlossenes Studium, bevorzugt mit Bezug zu Bildungsmanagement, Wirtschaft oder Informatik, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

 Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Bereich geförderte Weiterbildung, idealerweise mit Kenntnis von AZAV, SGB III und dem Bildungsgutschein

 Gutes Verständnis für KI- und Data-Themen und die Bereitschaft, dich in aktuelle Entwicklungen einzuarbeiten (Tiefe Programmierkenntnisse sind kein Muss.)

 Erste Erfahrung in fachlicher Führung oder in der Koordination von Teams und Partnern

 Strukturierte Arbeitsweise und ein sicherer Umgang mit Vorgaben, Nachweisen und Fristen

 Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse

 Arbeitskultur 
Dich erwartet eine lösungsorientierte und datengetriebene Arbeitsweise, eine offene Feedbackkultur sowie ein starker Teamspirit. Zwei vom gesamten StackFuel-Team gewählte Trustees unterstützen Dich bei Fragen und Anliegen als neutrale, vertrauliche Anlaufstelle.

Übernehme ab dem ersten Tag Verantwortung, bringe Deine eigenen Ideen aktiv ein, gestalte Prozesse nachhaltig und präge unsere Abläufe maßgeblich mit.

Wir arbeiten in einem hybriden Modell und sind üblicherweise 3 Tage pro Woche vor Ort in unserem Office in Berlin.

 Consumer Growth builds mobile and web experiences that help people become Kraken customers, fund their accounts, invest, earn, access new products, build wealth and stay lifelong clients. Product, engineering, design, data, and lifecycle marketing build together.
  
 The opportunity 
 Choose the right bets. Identify the client segments and problems worth solving. Own the roadmap and allocate effort against expected client value, commercial impact, and engineering cost. Set the baseline, target, and threshold for scaling; stop weak bets.

 Build NTU retention. Help newly transacting users build on their first transaction, discover further value, and form repeat investing and financial habits through their first weeks and months. Find where they stall and improve the steps that lead to lasting use.

 Retain and bring back established clients. Keep active clients engaged, address signs of lapsing, and reactivate clients who have stopped. Understand how needs change with tenure, holdings, and financial goals, then deepen the client’s relationship with Kraken.

 Make the next financial move useful. Test ways to support client intent: recurring deposits and buys, useful portfolio context, timely opportunities, or relevant Earn products. Choose from the evidence. Successful automated investing and Earn can create lasting value without frequent manual activity. Make rewards, access, and risks clear.

 Prove the commercial impact. Track retention by cohort and segment, linking behavior to retained balances, net inflows, product adoption, and revenue. Measure active engagement through useful actions, such as reviewing a portfolio or investing, and track successful automated habits separately. Distinguish inflows from asset-price gains, establish incremental impact, account for incentives and costs, and check that gains last after promotions end.

 Connect product and lifecycle. Partner with lifecycle marketing on push, email, web, and app journeys, from a relevant message to a useful financial action. Adapt to local payment habits and market requirements.

 Build and ship with the team. Turn the chosen problem into prototypes, requirements, and experiments with engineering, design, and data. Bring risk, compliance, and legal partners into design decisions. Balance client impact, reliability, maintainability, and delivery speed; scale what works.

  
 What you bring 
 Evidence that you’ve personally led consumer product changes that beat retention or expansion targets. Be ready to explain the baseline, target, result, timeframe, and your contribution, including the impact on revenue, assets, or retained balances.

 A clear account of what changed underneath the result: component behaviors or funnel rates such as repeat deposits, return-to-transaction conversion, successful recurring investments, or reactivation. Show how you established incremental impact and whether it lasted.

 Strong client and product judgment. You can choose a segment and problem worth pursuing, understand why clients return, hold, withdraw, or disengage, and turn that insight into a useful experience.

 Hands-on analytical depth. You query and validate your own data, diagnose cohorts and funnels, size opportunities, and design experiments that can detect a commercially meaningful effect.

 Commercial discipline. You can explain how market conditions, incentives, costs, and client trust affected your results, and use that evidence to decide whether an improvement is worth scaling.

 Senior ownership from decision through delivery. You’ve owned a roadmap, made product and technical trade-offs, allocated effort, stopped weak bets, and worked effectively with engineering, design, data, lifecycle marketing, and risk/compliance partners.

  
 Nice to haves 
 Experience with consumer investing, wealth, savings, fintech, or crypto products. Freemium gaming is nice-to-have as well.

 Experience building recurring investment, deposit, Earn, portfolio, or goal-based experiences.

 Experience adapting client journeys across markets and local financial behaviors.

jobs.title: Lead Product Designer
jobs.description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not only about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo.

 

📍London (Hybrid) / UK Remote | 💰 £90,000 - £120,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits

 

⭐Our Design team

We’re a team of 115+ designers, researchers, and brand experts led by Chief Design Officer Vuokko Aro. We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. Product Design makes up almost half of our design disciplines, working in tight-knit squads alongside research, product, and engineering to solve real customer problems at scale.

 

We design for the "magic moments"

We’ve built a bank that feels human, not just functional. Our product is our personality. We blend research, empathy, and craft to turn everyday interactions into memorable experiences.

Right now, we’re growing fast and looking for passionate designers to shape Monzo’s future and there’s a huge opportunity to make your mark.

Applying to this role, you’ll be in a standard hiring process for a Lead Product Designer, and we’ll find the perfect team for you along the way. 

 

🔑You’ll play a key role by...

  • Tackling the most complex and ambiguous design challenges, turning complexity into elegant, scalable solutions that empower teams and improve the customer experience.
  • Defining and delivering large-scale projects that connect initiatives across the business, using design methods to align strategies and drive impactful outcomes.
  • Leading the creation of compelling product visions, principles, and direction that inspire teams to build toward a shared future.
  • Using AI to level-up parts of your design workflow. Whether that’s ideation, analysis, prototyping or shipping production code to our app.
  • Raising the bar for visual execution, considering motion, interaction, and mental model clarity to deliver delightful and practical solutions.
  • Positively influencing our design system, tooling, and processes to improve how we create design at scale.
  • Driving improvements across the business by connecting your work to wider goals and leveraging cross-functional collaboration.
  • Acting as a role model in Design, sharing your work broadly, mentoring others, and contributing to the growth and success of the Design team.

 

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

  • You have a proven track record of delivering impactful, customer-centric native-app designs that solve complex problems and drive commercial outcomes.
  • You’re skilled at leading research, defining product visions, and aligning teams around a shared strategy.
  • You excel at creating modular, scalable solutions and have a strong grasp of how to use design artefacts to communicate insights effectively.
  • You’re a natural collaborator who can navigate multi-squad projects, align leadership, and drive clarity in ambiguous situations.
  • You’re passionate about improving design systems, processes, and ways of working to help teams deliver better outcomes at scale.
  • You’re a role model who actively contributes to the growth of the Design team through hiring, mentoring, and fostering a positive culture.
  • You’re excited about Monzo’s mission to make money work for everyone and are ready to make a significant impact on our customers and business.

 

🙌What’s in it for you

💰 £90,000 - £120,000 + Incenti

About Us 
 Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.
 Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.
 
 About the Role 
 As a Product Manager (ISR & Strike) at Harmattan AI, you will be at the heart of company strategy, driving the end-to-end definition, development, and delivery of our autonomous persistent ISR (Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance) and strike systems. You will own the evolution of our existing offer into a next-generation drone carrier platform integrated with proprietary Harmattan AI payloads. Working closely with R&D, you will translate operational needs into technical specifications, manage product configurations and versions, and ensure seamless execution from initial architecture to field deployment.
 
 Responsibilities 
 Product Definition & Roadmap: Consolidate the existing persistent ISR offer and define the product specification and multi-version roadmap for our autonomous drone carrier and Harmattan AI payload integrations based on market analysis, customer feedback, and technological feasibility.

 End-to-End Product Lifecycle Management: Own the product lifecycle from initial specification to full delivery across different system configurations, developing and maintaining timelines to ensure all milestones are met.

 Technical & R&D Coordination: Work hand-in-hand with R&D teams to oversee system engineering, architecture, and functional development, actively resolving technical challenges across R&D and industrialization phases.

 Cross-Functional Alignment: Act as the central interface between R&D, product, program, sales, and customers to align technical capabilities with operational mission requirements and ensure tender and project success.

 Resource & Configuration Management: Manage engineering resource allocation and product configurations to deliver reliable, high-performance autonomous systems on schedule.

 
 Candidate Requirements 
 Proven, hands-on experience within the modern DefTech ecosystem, specifically in defense products, drones/UAVs, or autonomous systems, is strictly required.

 End-to-End Product Development: Demonstrated track record of conducting complex technical products from initial specification through R&D to final delivery and industrialization.

 Technical & Systems Engineering Background: Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering (Systems, Aerospace, Electrical, Robotics, or Computer Science) or a related technical field, paired with deep knowledge of system engineering, unmanned aerial systems, and autonomous payloads.

 Customer & Mission-Oriented: Ability to translate complex ISR and strike mission requirements into concrete, scalable product features and configurations.

 Extreme Ownership: High level of accountability and autonomy, with the drive to take full responsibility for product definition, roadmap execution, and delivery outcomes.

 Collaborative Leadership & Active Listening: Strong communication and listening skills to build trust with R&D engineers, bridge technical and business stakeholders, and guide cross-functional teams without direct hierarchical authority.

 
 We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager Creative
jobs.description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Important: For this position, it is essential that you have a good command of the Dutch language, both written and spoken.

WPP Media

WPP Media is het wereldwijde mediacollectief van WPP, volledig gebouwd voor het AI-tijdperk. We bundelen het beste platform, de meest getalenteerde mensen en de sterkste partners om innovatieve oplossingen te creëren. Ons doel? Merken elke dag ongeëvenaarde groei bieden. Dit fundament vinden we in onze gedeelde kernwaarden:

  • We’re Extraordinary: We verleggen grenzen, dagen het gewone denken uit en doorbreken de status-quo in ons streven naar innovatie en groei.
  • We’re Open: We bouwen vertrouwen en begrip door naadloos samen te werken – met onze teams, klanten en partners.
  • We’re Optimistic: Een 'growth mindset' zit in ons DNA. We omarmen verandering als dé manier om het beste uit onszelf te halen.

Binnen WPP Media zijn wij het creatie team dat digitale campagnes nét dat beetje extra geeft. We mixen media, creativiteit en technologie om ideeën te maken die opvallen, raken en blijven hangen. Geen standaard banners of vluchtige clicks, maar slimme, opvallende en vaak verrassende creaties die écht aandacht trekken. Van interactieve formats tot dynamische campagnes: we zorgen dat merken niet alleen zichtbaar zijn, maar ook een glimlach, klik of wow-moment verdienen. Kortom – wij maken digitale media leuker, slimmer en effectiever.

Senior Project Manager
Bij ons draait alles om creatieve impact. En om dat vlekkeloos te laten verlopen, zoeken we een Senior Project Manager die energie krijgt van regelen, structureren én inspireren. Iemand die het creatieve proces strak organiseert, maar ook snapt dat de mooiste ideeën juist ontstaan als er ruimte is om te spelen.

Als Senior Project Manager Creative ben jij de spil tussen klant, jouw eigen creatie team en mediaspecialisten. Voor jouw klanten ben jij het eerste aanspreekpunt: je denkt mee, geeft advies en zorgt dat ideeën werkelijkheid worden.

Wat ga je concreet doen?

  • Je organiseert en bewaakt het projectplan van A tot Z, inclusief scope, deadlines en deliverables.
  • Je zorgt voor heldere projectstructuren en planning voor alle disciplines.
  • Je bent hét centrale aanspreekpunt voor klanten, interne teams en externe partners.
  • Je vertaalt creatieve en commerciële briefing naar uitvoerbare plannen en bewaakt verwachtingen.
  • Je identificeert risico’s vroegtijdig en zorgt dat issues worden opgelost voordat ze impact hebben.
  • Je bewaakt scopes, kwaliteitscriteria en KPI’s, en rapporteert hierover.
  • Je draagt bij aan verbeterde workflows, tools en werkwijzen zodat het team nog efficiënter werkt.
  • Je fungeert als brug tussen creatie, media en operations.

jobs.title: Product Manager ISR & Strike
jobs.description:
About Us 
 Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.
 Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.
 
 About the Role 
 As a Product Manager (ISR & Strike) at Harmattan AI, you will be at the heart of company strategy, driving the end-to-end definition, development, and delivery of our autonomous persistent ISR (Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance) and strike systems. You will own the evolution of our existing offer into a next-generation drone carrier platform integrated with proprietary Harmattan AI payloads. Working closely with R&D, you will translate operational needs into technical specifications, manage product configurations and versions, and ensure seamless execution from initial architecture to field deployment.
 
 Responsibilities 
 Product Definition & Roadmap: Consolidate the existing persistent ISR offer and define the product specification and multi-version roadmap for our autonomous drone carrier and Harmattan AI payload integrations based on market analysis, customer feedback, and technological feasibility.

 End-to-End Product Lifecycle Management: Own the product lifecycle from initial specification to full delivery across different system configurations, developing and maintaining timelines to ensure all milestones are met.

 Technical & R&D Coordination: Work hand-in-hand with R&D teams to oversee system engineering, architecture, and functional development, actively resolving technical challenges across R&D and industrialization phases.

 Cross-Functional Alignment: Act as the central interface between R&D, product, program, sales, and customers to align technical capabilities with operational mission requirements and ensure tender and project success.

 Resource & Configuration Management: Manage engineering resource allocation and product configurations to deliver reliable, high-performance autonomous systems on schedule.

 
 Candidate Requirements 
 Proven, hands-on experience within the modern DefTech ecosystem, specifically in defense products, drones/UAVs, or autonomous systems, is strictly required.

 Technical & Systems Engineering Background: Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering (Systems, Aerospace, Electrical, Robotics, or Computer Science) or a related technical field, paired with deep knowledge of system engineering, unmanned aerial systems, and autonomous payloads.

 Customer & Mission-Oriented: Ability to translate complex ISR and strike mission requirements into concrete, scalable product features and configurations.

 Extreme Ownership: High level of accountability and autonomy, with the drive to take full responsibility for product definition, roadmap execution, and delivery outcomes.

jobs.title: Cloud Platform - Senior Digital Product Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
La Cloud Platform Engineering recherche un(e) Senior Digital Product Manager basé(e) à Lille.

Chez Decathlon, nous croyons qu’il est essentiel de rendre les joies et les bienfaits du sport accessibles à tous.

Pour y parvenir, nos équipes ont besoin d’un système d’information performant, évolutif et sécurisé. La Cloud Platform Engineering (CPE) contribue à cet enjeu en développant des produits et services internes qui simplifient la vie des équipes tech, accélèrent la livraison, renforcent la sécurité et améliorent la maîtrise des opérations et des coûts.

Au sein de cet écosystème, notre offre Cloud Platform s’appuie sur plusieurs produits complémentaires :

  • 3S (Self Service Stack), notre plateforme interne de self-service cloud principalement orientée GCP ;
  • Cloud Kraft, qui complète notre offre de plateforme sur les services non industrialisé dans la 3S ;
  • notre service managé sur AWS, destiné à accompagner les équipes ayant des besoins spécifiques sur cet environnement.

Ensemble, ces produits permettent aux équipes de provisionner, déployer, faire évoluer et opérer leurs assets cloud via une approche standardisée, industrialisée et documentée, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur la sécurité, la résilience, l’observabilité et la maîtrise des coûts.

Ta mission

En tant que Senior Digital Product Manager, tu pilotes l’évolution de notre portefeuille de produits Cloud Platform, avec un rôle central sur 3S, Cloud Kraft et notre offre de service managé AWS.

Ton rôle est de maximiser la valeur apportée aux équipes utilisatrices en améliorant :

  • la clarté de l’offre et son positionnement ;
  • la qualité de l’expérience développeur ;
  • l’adoption des composants et services de la plateforme ;
  • la cohérence produit entre provisioning, standards, documentation, accompagnement et intégration dans l’écosystème engineering de Decathlon.

Tu interviens au croisement du produit, de la plateforme et des usages, avec une forte sensibilité à la scalabilité, à la sécurité, à la standardisation, à l’observabilité et à la maîtrise des coûts.

Tes responsabilités

Vision et stratégie produit

  • Définir et porter la vision produit de notre offre Cloud Platform et de ses différentes briques.
  • Clarifier le positionnement, les promesses, les cas d’usage et les priorités de 3S, Cloud Kraft et du service managé AWS.
  • Faire évoluer l’offre en cohérence avec les besoins des équipes, les contraintes d’engineering et les tendances du marché cloud.

Discovery & connaissance utilisateur

  • Mener une discovery continue auprès des équipes engineering, plateforme, sécurité et produit.
  • Comprendre les irritants, les besoins réels et les arbitrages entre autonomie, sécurité, standardisation, time-to-market et coût.
  • Transformer les retours terrain en opportunités produit concrètes et priorisées.

Roadmap & delivery

  • Piloter une roadmap multi-produits, en lien étroit avec les équipes d’ingénierie.
  • Prioriser les évolutions en fonction de la valeur utilisateur, de l’impact business et des enjeux techniques.
  • Suivre l’exécution jusqu’à la mise à disposition effective des fonctionnalités et services.

Adoption, documentation et change

  • Améliorer l’intégration des produits dans les parcours engineering et dans notre Internal Developper Platform (IDP).
  • Porter une documentation claire, maintenable et orientée usage.
  • Accompagner l’adoption via la pédagogie, les formations, les rituels et l’évangélisation produit.

Mesure de la performance produit

  • Définir les KPIs de performance, d’adoption, de satisfaction et d’efficience.
  • Utiliser la donnée pour éclairer les décisions produit et soutenir les arbitrages d’investissement.
  • Collaborer avec les parties prenantes concernées sur les enjeux FinOps et d’optimisation d’usage sur GCP comme sur AWS.

Ton profil

  • Expérience significative en Product Management sur un produit technique, une plateforme interne ou un environnement à forte dominante engineering.
  • Capacité à dialoguer avec des profils Dev, Ops, Platform, Security, FinOps.
  • Bonne compréhension des environnements

jobs.description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.
 
 We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.
 
 Here’s what this particular role covers.
 🛠️ About our Product Feature Owner Team 
 Wayve’s Product & Delivery team turns our AI Driver technology into valuable, scalable vehicle capabilities for global OEM partners. We work at the intersection of customer needs, product strategy and engineering delivery—defining what great looks like, aligning teams around a clear outcome and ensuring that Wayve’s technology can be brought to market safely and effectively.
 As part of this team, you’ll take end-to-end ownership of specific Collision Avoidance and Lane Keeping ADAS functionalities. You’ll work closely with OEM customers, product and engineering teams to define feature scope, set performance targets and guide delivery from concept through to production. Your work will directly shape how Wayve’s technology performs for customers and drivers as we progress towards higher levels of autonomy.
 
 🧠 Your day-to-day 
 Act as the accountable product owner for specific ADAS features, ensuring they are delivered on time, to the agreed specification and in line with customer and business needs.

 Partner closely with OEM customers to understand their requirements, represent their needs internally and align expectations without compromising Wayve’s product strategy.

 Work with feature group owners and engineering teams to define feature scope, specifications, performance targets and delivery plans.

 Engage throughout feature development, providing early feedback, participating in testing and supporting evaluation and validation activities.

 Serve as the central point of coordination between OEMs, product and engineering teams, creating clarity, resolving ambiguity and reducing misunderstandings.

 Identify risks early, manage trade-offs and keep teams aligned as feature requirements, customer priorities and the technology evolve.
 

 🧩 What you’ll be working on: 
 Owning the end-to-end lifecycle of ADAS features across Collision Avoidance and Lane Keeping, including Automatic Emergency Braking (AEB), Lane Keeping Assist (LKA), Evasive Steering Assist (ESA), Automatic Emergency Steering (AES) and Blind Spot Monitoring (BSM).

 Defining and evolving feature specifications in partnership with OEMs, engineering and product teams.

 Harmonising customer requirements across OEM partners to maximise reusable assets, scalability and efficient feature delivery.

 Setting clear performance targets and ensuring features meet customer requirements, internal capabilities and agreed delivery specifications.

 Supporting testing, evaluation and validation to ensure feature quality and readiness for production.

 Maintaining and evolving the strategic feature roadmap as Wayve’s technology advances towards higher levels of autonomy.

 Participating in agile planning and delivery rituals, helping teams manage dependencies, risks and priorities effectively.

 Ensuring feature delivery aligns with relevant automotive quality, safety and compliance expectations.
 

 🙌 You should apply if: 
 You have strong experience specifying and delivering ADAS features from concept through to production, particularly across Collision Avoidance or Lane Keeping functions such as AEB, LKA, ESA, AES or BSM.

 You understand automotive development processes, including requirements management, the V-model, ASPICE, quality and validation.

 You are confident working directly with OEM customers: understanding their needs, negotiating requirements and representing their perspective internally while maintaining a clear view of Wayve’s product strategy.

 You have sufficient technical depth to engage credibly with engineering teams on feature trade-offs, feasibility, testing, evaluation and validation.

 You are a strong cross-functional collaborator who can bridge technical and commercial perspectives, creating alignment across customers, product and engineering teams.

 You proactively identify risks and issues before they escalate, balancing immediate delivery needs with the longer-term product roadmap.

 You are comfortable in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment and can bring structure and clarity without adding unnecessary process.

 Experience shipping complete ADAS features into large-scale automotive production programmes would be valuable.

 Knowledge of automotive quality, safety and compliance standards—including ASPICE, SOTIF, functional safety, GSR-II and DCAS—would be valuable.

 Experience with machine learning, LLMs or recent generative-AI methods and architectures would be beneficial.

 You bring curiosity and a forward-looking approach to developing new ADAS capabilities and advancing the customer experience.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! 
 Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. 
 Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. 
 To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. 
 BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. 
 Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. 
 
 
 The opportunity 
 You work on our most strategic accounts and turn signed deals into live, revenue-generating deployments. On our largest global rollouts, successfully embedding BLP in the customer's system landscape (e.g., ERP) decides whether the go-live date holds. As a Technical Project Manager, you own the technical solution. You shape it with the customer's enterprise architects and IT leads, write the specification our engineers build from, and drive internal alignment and on-time delivery.
 What you'll do 
 Shape the technical solution with the customer’s business and IT departments on large and complex accounts, and push until answers are specific enough to build on.

 Turn requirements into a clear, implementable specification for our engineers. 

 Manage external and internal technical stakeholders, ensuring timely delivery and aligned priorities.

 Flag major development needs and blockers early, and bring a clear recommendation to the customer's steering committee.

 Support Project Managers on technical feasibility, effort and sequencing, through the first go-live.

 What you bring 
 3+ years in solution design, technical consulting, enterprise integration or technical product work.

 A track record of delivering complex technical projects from requirements engineering to go-live.

 Experience writing specifications that engineers can build from without a translation layer.

 Solid understanding of how enterprise systems exchange data, from file-based interfaces to APIs.

 Fluent German and English, spoken and written.

 Nice to have 
 Understanding of purchase-to-pay (P2P) and order-to-cash (O2C) processes, including the related finance and accounting workflows.

 Experience leading the technical design on multi-ERP and multi-country projects.

 Hands-on knowledge of several ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle, Infor), from both a functional and an integration perspective.

 Why BLP 
 A fast-growing, global AI company: the ideal place to learn and accelerate your career.

 Ownership of the technical design on our largest, most complex customer programs.

 At least one month of onboarding at our Zurich headquarters.

 Employee ownership through our participation program.

 Practical information 
 Location: our Munich or Cologne office (hybrid with 3+ office days per week)

 Travel: up to 10%, mostly within DACH

 Employment: full-time, permanent

What started as an encrypted email service has grown into an ecosystem of privacy-first products, including Proton Mail, VPN, Drive, Pass, and Calendar, used by millions of people worldwide.

We're profitable, independent, and building for the long term. Free from venture capital control and advertising-driven business models, we focus on what matters most: our users. Our work helps protect digital freedom, from everyday privacy to supporting journalists and activists in challenging environments.

Today, we're an international team of 700+ people, with offices across 9 countries. We have high standards for the people we hire and the work we do. You'll work alongside talented, driven colleagues who challenge each other, take ownership, and care about getting things right.

Explore our open-source projects.

The Role

We're building something new at Proton and we're hiring a Senior PM to lead it from the front.

This role sits at the intersection of product strategy, community dynamics, and Proton's mission to give people back control over their digital lives. You'll own the roadmap and execution for a product that brings privacy-first community experiences to millions of users. The team is small and senior; the scope is large. You’ll turn an ambitious product direction into clear strategy, crisp requirements, shipped experiences, and measurable outcomes.

We're looking for someone who has lived inside community products: who understands how engagement compounds, why moderation decisions shape culture, and how trust is built (and destroyed) at scale. If you've helped build or grow a platform where users interact, organize, and belong, and you want to do it in a way that doesn't exploit the people using it, this is the role.

What You'll Own

  • Define and drive the product strategy and roadmap end-to-end — from first principles through to shipped features — without waiting for direction from above
  • Own the metrics that matter: activation, engagement, retention, and community health. Set the targets, instrument the product to track them, and course-correct fast when signals shift
  • Translate deep knowledge of how online communities work — growth loops, moderation, network effects, content dynamics — into a clear product point of view and a prioritized execution plan
  • Lead cross-functional execution across a team of 6–12 engineers plus design, data, and growth — maintain velocity, surface blockers early, and keep the team focused on outcomes over activity
  • Drive structured discovery: user research, competitive analysis, and direct feedback loops that keep product decisions grounded in real behaviour, not assumptions
  • Represent the product externally when needed — to users, partners, and internal leadership — with clarity and confidence

Who You Are

  • 10+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time spent on a social, messaging, or community platform
  • Deep understanding of community product mechanics — you can reason clearly about engagement loops, content moderation trade-offs, trust and safety, and network effects without needing it explained
  • Analytically sharp: you define success in numbers, run structured experiments, and make data-informed calls without losing sight of user intuition
  • Strong, direct communicator — you write and speak with precision, push back when something doesn't make sense, and keep stakeholders aligned without over-meeting
  • Proven ability to lead a product autonomously: you identify the right problem, build the case, and drive it to shipped — without a roadmap handed to you

Who We Are 
 You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.
 We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.
 Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.
 Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

 The CPO office at Prosus is deliberately small. Nalden sets the direction: what we build and why. Jons, as Chief of Staff, creates the traction: the operating model, the portfolio, the prioritisation, and the decisions that turn direction into shipped product. Around them sit product managers, product marketing, growth, brand, content and design, and three product pods that do the building.

As Program Manager you run Nalden_OS — the operating loop of the CPO portfolio — day to day. You do not own the initiatives; you make sure each one has someone who does.
 You join while that loop is being built rather than maintained, so you shape it: what gets tracked, how reviews run, what a decision record looks like, and which reporting we stop doing because nobody reads it.

 Keep the whole portfolio visible, with an explicit owner on every line of work in flight across the CPO office and the product pods.

 Prepare the decisions: shape ambiguous work until it is ready to be decided on, and prepare the prioritisation calls and operating reviews for the CPO and the Chief of Staff.

 Make it move: track progress and dependencies across teams, surface blockers early, and escalate with a recommendation rather than a status update.

 Make it stick: capture decisions and the reasoning behind them, keep the information people rely on accurate, and turn what teams learn into knowledge someone will reuse.

 You do not make product decisions, approve teams' work, or become a reporting layer between teams and leadership. If teams spend more time updating you than shipping, the role is failing — and you would be the first to say so.

About Acodis
 Acodis is a Swiss software company based in Winterthur, providing AI-driven document processing for global Life Sciences companies. We help Quality and Regulatory teams move from document-centric to data-driven ways of working.
 The Mandate
 We are looking for an experienced freelance Product Manager to turn our AI platform into dedicated product solutions for two use cases. Working directly with management and our product engineering team, you will own both from discovery to market launch.
 Quality – Batch Record Review: AI-assisted review of executed batch records: checking completeness and correctness of entries, flagging deviations and GMP-relevant exceptions, and shortening review cycles ahead of batch disposition.
 Regulatory – CMC & Regulatory Submissions: Extraction and reuse of CMC data for submissions (CTD Module 3), consistency checks between source documents and submission content, and support for variations and post-approval changes.
 Mandate Deliverables
 Product definition & validation: Customer interviews, validated user workflows and value cases, and engineering-ready specifications and roadmap for both use cases.
 Pilot support: In our running pilots, including success criteria and a GxP-compliant validation approach.
 Go-to-market: Positioning, messaging, input and launch materials, together with the commercial team.
 Required Expertise
 8+ years in product management or product consulting for digital, AI or enterprise software in Life Sciences.
 Hands-on expertise in batch record review and GMP manufacturing, or in CMC and regulatory submissions, with a solid understanding of GxP, data integrity and computerised system validation.
 Track record of taking products from concept to market, working independently on defined mandates.
 Nice to have: Experience with AI/LLM-based document processing, data pipelines, or platforms such as Veeva, MasterControl, Snowflake or Databricks.
 Mandate Details
 Duration & workload: 3–6 months from Jan/Feb 2027, 80–100%, extension possible.
 Location: Fully remote; no on-site presence in Winterthur required, but possible.
 Contract: Freelance (self-employed or via your own company)
 What We Offer
 A clearly scoped mandate with autonomy in how you deliver it.
 Direct access to management, engineering and customers, with short decision paths.
 The chance to shape two flagship products, with potential for a follow-on mandate.
 How to Apply
 Please upload your CV and relevant references, availability and daily rate to our recruiting platform.
