jobs.title: Head of Compliance Product
jobs.description:
We're hiring a Head of Compliance Product to lead the products at the heart of Elliptic and define what they become in the age of AI.
 Compliance is where Elliptic began and where our commercial core sits today. Some of the world's largest exchanges, banks and government agencies rely on our screening, monitoring and investigation products, and the industry they serve is at an inflection point. Compliance teams everywhere are looking to AI to make their work dramatically more efficient, freeing their people to focus on the judgement calls that genuinely need a human, with every automated decision auditable and explainable. Elliptic is building that future with our customers, not just for them, and this role owns it.
 You will lead the product managers responsible for our core compliance portfolio, spanning wallet and transaction screening, continuous monitoring, on-chain investigations and risk configuration, and you will drive the product side of our agentic compliance programme alongside our design partners. Much of what you build will have no precedent. You will be inventing the category, inside the company with the data, intelligence and customer trust to win it.
 This is a player-coach role reporting to the VP of Product. You will lead and grow a team of product managers and personally own some of the hardest problems on the roadmap. The product organisation is centred in London with a growing US presence.
  
  
 What you'll do
 Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for Elliptic's compliance portfolio, and define what these products become as AI reshapes how compliance work gets done.

 Lead product for our agentic compliance programme : AI capabilities that make compliance work faster and better, with auditability and explainability designed in from the start.

 Lead, coach and grow a team of product managers. Hire well, develop people deliberately, and set the standard for how a modern, AI-augmented PM works. Developing product talent is a core output of this role, not a side effect.

 Stay obsessively close to customers, in creative ways : Methods such as design partnerships, analyst shadowing, product instrumentation, and internal dogfooding before anything ships come naturally to you to increase the chances of success. Convert ambiguous market signal into a clear view of what to build and why.

 Prioritise ruthlessly. Demand will always exceed capacity. Sequence zero-to-one bets against the needs of products customers depend on today, and say yes or no credibly, with reasoning people can engage with.

 Execute with rigour, raising velocity and quality together. Own outcomes, not shipping dates. Use AI across your own workflow and your team's to learn faster and ship better at the same time, in a domain where mistakes carry real consequences.

  
  
 What this role is not
 Not a compliance officer role. You are building the products compliance teams use, not running a compliance programme.

 Not a caretaker role. The core products are successful and deeply embedded; the mandate is reinvention.

 Not a management-only layer. You will lead product managers and personally do product work on the hardest problems.

  
  
 Who we're looking for
 10+ years building software products , including leading and developing product managers, with people who are better because they worked with you.

 A genuine zero-to-one track record : an ambiguous problem in a complex domain, taken from nothing to a product real users depend on.

 Depth in financial crime compliance from the product side (transaction monitoring, screening, KYC/EDD or investigations), built inside an exchange, a bank, a fintech or a compliance technology company.

 Working knowledge of crypto and blockchain as a baseline; deep blockchain analytics experience is a strong plus.

 AI-native : AI is embedded in how you work and build every day, you have shipped AI or agentic capabilities to production, and you raise the AI capability of teams around you. If AI has not materially changed how you build product in the last two years, this is not the right role.

 Deep executional rigour : you break complex problems into shippable steps, sweat the details that determine quality, and reliably carry work over the line.

 High self-sufficiency : you find high-value opportunities no one assigned you, create clarity rather than wait for it, and are comfortable owning a broad remit while the map is still being drawn.

 Continuous systems thinking : you look for the repeatable system behind every one-off fix, building leverage so each problem solved makes the whole team permanently faster.

 A data-informed operating style : you instrument what you ship, argue from evidence, and change your mind when the data disagrees.

 Judgement under ambiguity : you know which decisions to make fast and which to hold open when precedent does not exist.

 Comfort in regulated, high-stakes environments : you treat trust, explainability and defensibility as features, and opera

jobs.title: Medical Product Owner
jobs.description:
Vision RT is a fast-growing MedTech company transforming radiation therapy for cancer patients by helping make it more accurate, effective, and comfortable. The company is the inventor of, and a market leader in, Surface Guided Radiation Therapy (SGRT). This technology uses advanced 3D cameras to track surface data, providing enhanced guidance across every step of the radiotherapy workflow.

 

 Our systems are used in over 3,000 clinics worldwide, including in 29 of the top 30 Best Hospitals for Cancer (source: US News and World Report 2026 rankings).

 

 The company is recognized as one of Britain’s fastest-growing private tech companies, as featured in the 2025 Sunday Times 100 Tech list. Vision RT is also a recipient of the 2026 King’s Award for Enterprise, our fifth in 10 years. It is the UK’s most prestigious accolade for business excellence.

 

 Company video (Available on application page)

 

 With around 400+ employees globally and offices in the UK, Poland, and the USA, Vision RT operates independently as part of the Danish company William Demant Invest A/S, one of the world’s largest investors in healthcare companies. Employees benefit from the security and reach of being part of a large global enterprise, combined with the agility and innovation of a startup.

 

 Vision RT is a company with strong values, a clear mission, and a bright future. It is an exciting and rewarding organization in which to work.

 

 

 

 

 

 About the role: 

 

 As a Product Owner, you will support Product Management in creating the company Product Portfolio. This role involves collaborating with various stakeholders to align on delivery strategies, converting roadmap goals into actionable plans, and prioritizing the product backlog. You will have daily contact with engineering R&D teams, helping them understand customer needs and translate those into tangible solutions. Enhancing user experience and maintaining a structured backlog are essential. 

 

 Travel Expectation: Approximately 10-25%, mainly EMEA 

 Key Responsibilities will include: 

 Collaborate closely with Key Stakeholders to align on the delivery strategy, goals, and objectives outlined in the Roadmap, considering both commercial and customer aspects.

 Convert Roadmap objectives into a cohesive vision (e.g., through Product Goals and Sprint goals) for the R&D Teams, reflected in the Product Backlog prioritisation.

 Emphasise the end-to-end user experience by utilising user journey mapping and working in partnership with Usability engineers and UX designers.

 Provide and maintain a well-structured Product Backlog, clearly and transparently communicating requirements and deadlines. Optimise the scope of the projects to achieve business goals by delivering specific, measurable Key Results for the Teams.

 Monitor Product Roadmap progress and communicate progress and status to Key Stakeholders. Monitor Product performance to guide future initiatives.

 Collect product feedback systematically and translate it into user needs in alignment with the Product Manager and PO Team. Collaborate closely with the PO Team.

 Ensure the SGRT product is developed incrementally, releasing new functional features after each Sprint, to soliciting customer feedback and providing customer value.

 Consistently engage with the Teams to provide feedback on ongoing work and clarify requirements during Scrum/LeSS events (dailies, refinements, planning, etc.). Ensure the Teams are aware of customer and commercial objectives.

 Be available for clarification, providing guidance, challenging and answering when necessary to arrive at the best possible understanding of issues and proposed solutions.

 Offer product training when needed.

 Assist with SGRT community events and exhibitions when needed.

 

 Essential Skills & Experience 

 Background in the medical device industry, ideally with experience in Radiation Therapy; prior work as a Medical Physics is a strong advantage.

 Strong interest in technology and innovation, with a proactive approach to continuous improvement.

 Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement abilities.

 Proven track record of leading or contributing to process enhancements and cross-functional projects, regardless of formal scope.

 Self-driven and highly motivated, with a collaborative mindset.

 Skilled in enabling team success through problem-solving, user-focused thinking, and effective project or service delivery—well-aligned with product management principles.

 Native or fluent proficiency in English. 

 Desirable Skills & Experience 

 Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and foster a culture of innovation. 

 Expertise in defining user needs, requirements, and planning product roadmaps. 

 Experience working within agile teams and familiarity with agile methodologies. 

 Previous experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or Project Manager, preferably within the medical industry. 

 Vision RT is an Equal Opport

Our Product Owners also take an active role in product launches, ensuring internal stakeholders are trained on the latest product capabilities.

You will need a unique blend of business and technical savvy, a big-picture vision and attention to detail, and the drive to make that vision a reality. You must enjoy spending time learning the product and understanding its users in order to make the best design decisions for our clients.

jobs.title: Fospha - Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Fospha

Fospha is the measurement system enterprise retail and ecommerce brands run their business on. We give marketing teams one clear, daily view of what's actually working - across every channel and everywhere they sell, from their website to Amazon and TikTok Shop - down to the level of a single ad or piece of creative. It replaces guesswork and gut feel with a number marketing, finance and agencies can all trust and act on. Brands including Dyson, Gymshark, and Lululemon use Fospha every day to decide where budget should move next. We've spent over a decade building this, with more than $40 billion in marketing spend now optimised through the platform - and we're scaling fast across London, Mumbai and Austin.

The role

We're hiring two Product Managers to own major parts of the Fospha platform. You'll decide what gets built and why, get it shipped, and prove it worked for clients.

This is a role for a doer. You'll own a significant product area end to end, set its direction, and run several initiatives at once. A delivery manager and engineering lead run day-to-day delivery alongside you, so your time goes on the decisions that matter: which client problem to solve, what it's worth, what to cut, and whether what shipped actually moved the needle.

You'll join an established team, supporting our continued transformation in a post-AI era. We're looking for people who will push how we structure and execute to maximise the value of Product work, not take their first step into Product management.

What you'll do

  • Own a product area end to end. Take initiatives from problem, sizing and discovery through build, launch and adoption. Make the sequencing calls for your area and run several initiatives in parallel.
  • Start every initiative with why. Before anything is built, be clear on the client problem, the evidence for it, the expected impact for clients, what it's worth commercially, how it fits our pricing and packaging, and how it advances company strategy. Fospha's business strategy hinges on its product strategy, so every initiative should trace back to it. Say no to good ideas that aren't the most important thing.
  • Stay close to clients. Don't wait to be invited: set up your own client calls as well as joining others', run interviews and prototype sessions, and pair what clients tell you with what the usage data shows. Know what clients see on screen and what they do with it.
  • Decide quickly on imperfect information. Know when the evidence is strong enough to act, make the call, and change course when the evidence changes, including stopping work that isn't landing.
  • Work AI-first. Use AI to compress discovery synthesis, analysis, spec writing and stakeholder communication. Build and refine your own agents, workflows and prototypes, and work with engineers on what can be prototyped with AI coding tools. Share what works with other PMs and feed improvements back to Product Ops, so the whole team gets faster.
  • Prove it worked. Set success thresholds before build starts, check adoption and usage after release, and act on the result. Shipped is not the same as worked.
  • Give people what they need to decide. Know what information a decision-maker needs at each point, and give them exactly that: a one-line recommendation for an exec, the full detail for an engineer. Present with confidence to senior leaders, internally and at clients.
  • Raise the bar. Give direct, useful feedback, take it well, and hold your own work to a high standard.

What you'll bring (must-haves)

  1. 3+ years as a Product Manager, or in an adjacent role with experience you can clearly apply to product management. Either way, you can point to problems you owned end to end: deciding what to do, getting it delivered, and measuring whether it worked against success criteria set upfront.
  2. 2+ years making decisions from data yourself - product analytics (funnels, usage, retention) and commercial data - pulling and checking your own numbers rather than waiting for an analyst.
  3. A track record of connecting your work to commercial outcomes. You've sized opportunities in revenue or retention terms, built business cases, and shaped pricing, packaging or monetisation decisions with commercial teams.
  4. Hands-on client experience. You've run customer discovery, joined sales and account calls, and turned what clients experience into a clear, evidenced problem statement.
  5. Confidence in presenting to peers and senior stakeholders. You're confident making and presenting recommendations to leaders across the business, advocating for data-backed decisions.

Brands including Dyson, Gymshark, and Lululemon use Fospha every day to decide where budget should move next. We've spent over a decade building this, with more than $40 billion in marketing spend now optimised through the platform - and we're scaling fast across London, Mumbai and Austin.

The role

We're hiring two Product Managers to own major parts of the Fospha platform. You'll decide what gets built and why, get it shipped, and prove it worked for clients.

This is a role for a doer. You'll own a significant product area end to end, set its direction, and run several initiatives at once. A delivery manager and engineering lead run day-to-day delivery alongside you, so your time goes on the decisions that matter: which client problem to solve, what it's worth, what to cut, and whether what shipped actually moved the needle.

You'll join an established team, supporting our continued transformation in a post-AI era. We're looking for people who will push how we structure and execute to maximise the value of Product work, not take their first step into Product management.

What you'll do

  • Own a product area end to end. Take initiatives from problem, sizing and discovery through build, launch and adoption. Make the sequencing calls for your area and run several initiatives in parallel.
  • Start every initiative with why. Before anything is built, be clear on the client problem, the evidence for it, the expected impact for clients, what it's worth commercially, how it fits our pricing and packaging, and how it advances company strategy. Fospha's business strategy hinges on its product strategy, so every initiative should trace back to it. Say no to good ideas that aren't the most important thing.
  • Stay close to clients. Don't wait to be invited: set up your own client calls as well as joining others', run interviews and prototype sessions, and pair what clients tell you with what the usage data shows. Know what clients see on screen and what they do with it.
  • Decide quickly on imperfect information. Know when the evidence is strong enough to act, make the call, and change course when the evidence changes, including stopping work that isn't landing.
  • Work AI-first. Use AI to compress discovery synthesis, analysis, spec writing and stakeholder communication. Build and refine your own agents, workflows and prototypes, and work with engineers on what can be prototyped with AI coding tools. Share what works with other PMs and feed improvements back to Product Ops, so the whole team gets faster.
  • Prove it worked. Set success thresholds before build starts, check adoption and usage after release, and act on the result. Shipped is not the same as worked.
  • Give people what they need to decide. Know what information a decision-maker needs at each point, and give them exactly that: a one-line recommendation for an exec, the full detail for an engineer. Present with confidence to senior leaders, internally and at clients.
  • Raise the bar. Give direct, useful feedback, take it well, and hold your own work to a high standard.

What you'll bring (must-haves)

  1. 3+ years as a Product Manager, or in an adjacent role with experience you can clearly apply to product management. Either way, you can point to problems you owned end to end: deciding what to do, getting it delivered, and measuring whether it worked against success criteria set upfront.
  2. 2+ years making decisions from data yourself - product analytics (funnels, usage, retention) and commercial data - pulling and checking your own numbers rather than waiting for an analyst.
  3. A track record of connecting your work to commercial outcomes. You've sized opportunities in revenue or retention terms, built business cases, and shaped pricing, packaging or monetisation decisions with commercial teams.
  4. Hands-on client experience. You've run customer discovery, joined sales and account calls, and turned what clients experience into a clear, evidenced problem statement.
  5. Confidence in presenting to peers and senior stakeholders. You're confident making and presenting recommendations to leaders across the business, advocating for data-backed decisions.

jobs.title: Manager, Product Marketing

Company Description

 Support Commercial Enablement: Create clear and effective collateral that helps commercial teams communicate the value of products and capabilities to merchants.

 Clear Storytelling Ability: Able to simplify complex concepts and communicate them in a clear, compelling way.

 Data-Driven Mindset: Comfortable using data to evaluate performance and guide improvements.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager - Agent Builder
jobs.description:
Auditors sign their name to every conclusion. An agent can do the heavy lifting, but only if the auditor can see how each conclusion was reached and trace it back to its source.
 Agent Builder is where firms turn their own procedures into agents their whole team can run, in Alwin by DataSnipper, our agentic automation platform for audit and finance. Built well, an agent makes quality a property of the procedure, not of who happened to be staffed on the engagement.
 You'll own Agent Builder and the agents firms build with it. Your users are the people at firms who build agents, and the methodology and quality teams who approve them for client work.
 This is a technical PM role. You'll shape the harness each agent runs in: the context it sees, the tools it uses, and where a person reviews its work. You'll own the feedback loops that improve agents after release. You'll work as a peer to the Agent Builder engineering team, and with our Agent Runtime and Evals teams here in Amsterdam.
 
 
 About DataSnipper 
 
 The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust. 
 We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.
 At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.
 For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.
 And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers . Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.
 If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way. 
 
 
 The problems you'll own 
 
 A firm's procedure must become a harness an agent can follow, with the right context, tools and review points

 Models are non-deterministic, but audit work must be defensible: traceable, attributed and reviewed

 A firm will only rely on an agent it can test, approve and trace

 Reviewer feedback must make agents better, with the firm's approval and without anything reaching another client

 Methodology, models and standards all change. Agents in use must keep up without breaking work in progress
 

 What you'll do 
 
 Own the Agent Builder strategy and roadmap, and make the trade-offs explicit

 Design the harness with engineering: how context is assembled, how tools are defined and called, and where a person must review

 Decide what builders control and what the platform sets, so agents can encode real methodology and stay consistent

 Build the feedback loops: turn run traces and reviewer edits into eval cases, regression tests and changes the firm approves

 Set the quality gates an agent must pass before release, and test every new model or methodology version before it reaches live work

 Report agent quality with a stated method and sample

 Prototype in code before you write specs. Then write short specs and decision memos that engineers can build from

 Spend time with the firms that build and approve agents, and turn what our forward-deployed teams learn into product, not one-off fixes

 
 What you bring 
 
 A technical background: software, ML or infrastructure engineering, or several years as a technical PM on developer or AI platforms

 Hands-on experience shipping agent systems in production: context and retrieval, tool calling, orchestration, structured outputs, retries and fallbacks

 Eval practice: building datasets, calibrating LLM judges against human labels, offline and online evaluation, and regression testing across model versions

 Observability for LLM systems: traces, cost and latency, and classifying failures so you fix causes, not symptoms

 System design skills: schemas, versioning, permissions, event logs and A

jobs.title: Product Feature Owner - Parking
jobs.description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.
 
 We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.
 
 Here’s what this particular role covers.
 🛠️ About our Product Feature Owner Team 
 Wayve’s Product & Delivery team turns our AI Driver technology into valuable, scalable vehicle capabilities for global OEM partners. We work at the intersection of customer needs, product strategy and engineering delivery—defining what great looks like, aligning teams around a clear outcome and ensuring that Wayve’s technology can be brought to market safely and effectively.
 As part of this team, you’ll take end-to-end ownership of specific Parking functionalities. You’ll work closely with OEM customers, product and engineering teams to define feature scope, set performance targets and guide delivery from concept through to production. Your work will directly shape how Wayve’s technology performs for customers and drivers as we progress towards higher levels of autonomy.
 
 🧠 Your day-to-day 
 Act as the accountable product owner for specific Parking features, ensuring they are delivered on time, to the agreed specification and in line with customer and business needs.

 Partner closely with OEM customers to understand their requirements, represent their needs internally and align expectations without compromising Wayve’s product strategy.

 Work with feature group owners and engineering teams to define feature scope, specifications, performance targets and delivery plans.

 Partner with systems, hardware, perception, platform, safety and supplier teams to shape the Parking sensor and compute architecture.

 Drive integration and issue resolution across the Parking sensor stack, including ultrasonic sensors (USS) and surround-view cameras (SVCs).

 Engage throughout feature development, providing early feedback, participating in testing and supporting evaluation and validation activities.

 Identify risks early, manage trade-offs and keep teams aligned as customer priorities, platform constraints and the technology evolve.
 

 🧩 What you’ll be working on: 
 Owning the end-to-end lifecycle of Parking features, including Park Distance Control, Rear-AEB, Auto-Park Assist, Remote Park Assist and Memory Parking.

 Defining and evolving feature specifications in partnership with OEMs, engineering and product teams.

 Translating sensor, compute and platform constraints into clear feature scope, performance targets and delivery trade-offs.

 Leading integration across the Parking sensor stack, including USS and SVCs, and resolving sensor-specific performance and integration issues.

 Harmonising customer requirements across OEM partners to maximise reusable assets, scalability and efficient feature delivery.

 Setting clear performance targets and ensuring features meet customer requirements, internal capabilities and agreed delivery specifications.

 Supporting testing, evaluation and validation to ensure feature quality and readiness for production.

 Maintaining and evolving the strategic feature roadmap as Wayve’s technology advances towards higher levels of autonomy.

 Participating in agile planning and delivery rituals, helping teams manage dependencies, risks and priorities effectively.

 Ensuring feature delivery aligns with relevant automotive quality, safety and compliance expectations.
 

 🙌 You should apply if: 
 You have strong experience specifying and delivering Parking features from concept through to production, particularly Park Distance Control, Rear-AEB, Auto-Park Assist, Remote Park Assist or Memory Parking.

 You understand automotive development processes, including requirements management, the V-model, ASPICE, quality and validation.

 You are confident working directly with OEM customers: understanding their needs, negotiating requirements and representing their perspective internally while maintaining a clear view of Wayve’s product strategy.

 You have sufficient technical depth to engage credibly with engineering teams on Parking feature trade-offs, feasibility, testing, evaluation and validation.

 You have experience defining and integrating automotive Parking sensor systems, including USS and SVCs, with practical knowledge of interfaces, calibration, diagnostics, supplier management and sensor-specific integration and performance issues.

 You have delivered ADAS or Parking features on resource-constrained automotive SoCs, with a practical understanding of how compute, memory, bandwidth, latency and thermal budgets shape system architecture, feature behaviour, performance and customer experience.

 You are a strong cross-functional collaborator who can bridge technical and commercial perspectives, creating alignment across customers, product, systems, hardware, perception, platform, safety and engineering teams.

jobs.title: Senior Product Delivery Manager, Production (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
The role

We are seeking a dynamic, hands-on Senior Product Delivery Manager at HelloFresh. This role is pivotal to the future of our fulfillment network. You will be at the helm of further developing and deploying a high-profile, highly complex strategic project that fundamentally redefines our production methods and capabilities across our DCs.
Working closely with Tech and Operations Leadership, you will be responsible for taking our new, next-generation production setup and refining its processes, equipment, and layouts. Once optimized, you will lead the charge in deploying this new operational blueprint into other DCs across our international markets.
This is not a traditional desk-bound product role; it requires a strong operational background, deep understanding of physical process design, and the ability to bridge the gap between high-level strategy and on-the-ground execution. The international role will be based in our Berlin office and will involve frequent travel to our local warehouses across markets and potentially extended stays during roll-out periods.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What you’ll do

  • Process and Equipment Design: You will actively design, evaluate, and refine DC layouts, operational workflows, and physical equipment setups for our next-generation production models.
  • Project Deployment & Rollout: Working cross-functionally, you will be the driving force for the end-to-end implementation and deployment of production technologies. Including this complex new production model across multiple international fulfillment centers.
  • Lean Management & Continuous Improvement: You will apply Lean principles to continuously test, tweak, and optimize the operational setup and production capacity before, during, and after site rollouts.
  • Stakeholder Management & Collaboration: You will act as the central node between global engineering, local operations teams, tech, and senior leadership. You will manage expectations, align priorities, and ensure smooth execution across a matrixed international environment.
  • Problem Solving: You will identify, prioritize, structure, and solve an array of complex physical and systematic business problems on the shop floor, using analytics, engineering principles, and strong business judgment.
  • Strategy and Planning: You will support the development of rollout strategies and produce the resulting project plans, ensuring that we deploy at scale without disrupting ongoing operations.
  • Documentation and Standardization: You will drive towards clear and structured project documentation, clearly defining and outlining the solutions, requirements, … You will help us create standard deployment playbooks which speed up bringing our solutions to market.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience: You have a strong track record within a production, manufacturing, or supply chain environment.
  • Design Expertise: You possess highly specific, demonstrated experience in DC layout design, process design, and equipment design/optimization.
  • Methodology: You have deep expertise in Lean Management principles and continuous improvement methodologies within a physical operational setting.
  • Leadership: You have exceptional project delivery and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and guide teams in an environment that requires intense cross-functional collaboration.
  • Academic Record: An excellent academic record with a degree from a top-tier college or University (Engineering, Supply Chain, or Business degrees strongly preferred).
  • Consulting Experience: Demonstrated experience at an (operational / management) consulting firm with a focus on manufacturing/operations projects is a big plus.
  • Autonomy: You have a demonstrated ability to deliver heavy-hitting impact and work highly independently in an unstructured, fast-moving, and constantly evolving high-growth environment.
  • Mobility: You have an interest and willingness to frequently travel abroad (~50%).

What we offer

Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.

  • Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.

 In this role, you'll focus on making the JustPlay ecosystem feel seamless for players - identifying where the experience breaks between games and platform, turning those gaps into product opportunities, and setting direction around the solutions that can have the greatest impact on our key metrics. You'll work closely with Design, Engineering, Data, and game teams to align around priorities, make trade-offs, and drive outcomes across the ecosystem.

About Kernel
 Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?
 
 Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.
 
 Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.
 
 Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent Kernel ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. We have strong product-market fit: Ops, data, and revenue teams at  Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva, and Checkout  already use Kernel across their enterprise systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.
 
 We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators, and we are growing 10x YoY .
 
 The role 
 You will own one of Kernel’s product areas end-to-end, working directly with the founders and the engineering team
 Own all stages from discovery to implementation for our core product areas and bets

 Data- and metrics-driven (without being obstinate about it)

 Tolerate (maybe even relish) ambiguity, and know when to make decisions quickly vs. when something needs more thought

 Bridge the link between our customers and our engineering team

 Help shape the product roadmap and vision for Kernel

 
 What we’re looking for
 We are looking for a full-stack product thinker who can own and lead product work from discovery to implementation.

 At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing.

Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive.

About Us 

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem .

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential.  We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Product Partnerships to own and build those relationships.

 generating sales pipeline or supplier commission revenue. Its goal is to make Perk’s product

 You’ll determine where strategic relationships can unlock the most customer value, build and

 Build the Product Partnerships playbook: Establish how Perk evaluates, prioritises, launches, measures, and manages product partnerships as this function grows.

 What We’re Looking For 
 Proven experience in strategic partnerships, ecosystem partnerships, business development, or a product-adjacent role within SaaS, fintech, or B2B technology.

 Experience building and managing complex relationships with technology or platform companies, ideally including developer, API, certification, or marketplace programmes.

 Comfortable working with Product and Engineering and understanding technical concepts such as APIs, OAuth, data models, sandboxes, and integration dependencies without needing to be an engineer.

 Ability to distinguish between an interesting partnership and one that will meaningfully improve Perk’s product or customer experience.

 Strong relationship-building, negotiation

jobs.title: Product Manager - Storage
jobs.description:
About Mistral 
 Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.
 We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.
 
 The team
 Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud for Europe. Our customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the Cloud Platform team builds the systems that make that possible, from compute orchestration and Kubernetes to bare metal, storage, and networking.
 European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. You will design and ship the layer every sovereign AI deployment depends on and shape the team building it.
 
 The Role
 As a Storage Product Manager on the Cloud team, you will own the strategy and roadmap for Mistral's storage product portfolio. You have a deep understanding of the storage stack from block storage, distributed filesystems, object storage, and the evolving storage technology that accelerate AI/ML and HPC workloads. You understand what is slowing down the infrastructure teams building on Mistral Cloud — translating those insights into products that are flexible, easy to build on, and performant at scale.
 You will work closely with engineering and cross-functional teams to build new products and enhance existing offerings, ensuring alignment with technological advancements, customer expectations, and market trends. This is a highly critical role with significant influence over the future of AI compute and storage products.
 
 What You’ll Do
 Product strategy: Define and execute the product vision for Mistral's storage offerings — including distributed filesystem, block, and object storage to keep pace with the needs of AI training and inference at scale.

 Cross-functional leadership: Partner with Cloud Software Engineering, and SRE to define technical specifications, execution timelines, and the performance, reliability, scalability, and cost targets the different storage products must hit.

 Data strategy and architecture: Drive the data lifecycle, tiering, durability, and failure-domain strategy in close partnership with engineering.

 Roadmap ownership: Own and prioritize the storage product roadmap, balancing customer requests, technical feasibility, and business impact.

 Customer discovery: Build deep relationships with the infrastructure teams building on Mistral Cloud, understand their storage needs and pain points, and act as their voice inside the company.

 Market Analysis: Research trends, opportunities, and challenges in the storage domain, and use these insights to guide product development and positioning.

 Technical translation: Distill complex technical tradeoffs into clear, compelling narratives and decision documents for company leadership.

 Performance monitoring: Track and analyze product performance metrics and use data-driven insights to guide product enhancements and future direction.

 
 What We’re Looking For
 8+ years of experience in product management, with a strong focus on storage and cloud infrastructure, particularly in high-performance or AI-driven environments

 Strong understanding of storage technologies, including file system, block and object storage.

 Solid technical foundation and cloud-infrastructure knowledge. You’re comfortable reasoning about API semantics, control-plane vs data-plane behavior, system events and lifecycle, multi-tenant operational realities. You can engage with engineering teams as a peer, not as a translator. You can challenge an engineering tradeoff, not just relay one.

 Track record of shipping technically complex platform products with measurable impact.

 Strong analytical instincts with the ability to use data to inform and defend multi-year infrastructure decisions.

 Ability to align and inspire cross-functional teams without direct authority, and to communicate credibly with executives, engineers, and customers.

 Low ego, high bias for action, and comfort in ambiguity — equally at home crafting a strategy narrative and diving into metrics, a UX detail, or a customer escalation.

 
 Bonus
 You can reason about cloud storage economics, and how tiering across hot, warm, and cold tiers affects cost

 You've designed, or worked closely on, backup, replication, or disaster recovery products

 You're comfortable discussing storage performance characteristics: t

jobs.title: Product Manager, Developer Ecosystem
jobs.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. Itâs built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internetâs largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .

 About the Team 

 Reddit's developer ecosystem is one of the biggest opportunities to make Reddit more useful, expressive, extensible, and valuable. Today, most people who build on Reddit are developers: they write code, use Devvit, work with APIs, and ship apps or games through a relatively technical workflow. That ecosystem is growing quickly and remains critical.

 But the future is bigger than developers alone. AI-assisted building is changing who can create software. The next generation of Reddit apps, games, tools, community agents, content formats, and workflows should be buildable by many more people: developers, technically curious creators, moderators, community builders, game designers, data partners, and eventually people who can describe what they want without needing to code it by hand.

 The Developer Ecosystem team owns the product systems that help this broader set of builders discover opportunities, create successfully, launch high-quality apps and games, reach the right users and communities, adopt new platform capabilities, and keep improving after launch. This includes surfaces and systems like developers.reddit.com, AI-assisted creation, app review, developer and creator onboarding, app marketplace experiences, platform capabilities, best practices, and support for emerging creator categories.

 About the Role 

 We are looking for a Staff Product Manager to lead Reddit's Builder Ecosystem product strategy. This person will define the roadmap for how Reddit moves from a developer-only ecosystem to a broader builder ecosystem where AI-assisted and no-code creation become first-class parts of the platform.

 The role spans developer growth, creator onboarding, AI-assisted building, app quality, ecosystem incentives, platform capabilities, app marketplace strategy, operational tooling, feature adoption, and new builder categories.

 This is a high-ambiguity platform role with direct business, product, and community impact. The right PM will be able to bridge two worlds: they should understand the needs of serious developers and platform engineers, while also having strong conviction that Reddit can unlock a much larger wave of builders by making creation more accessible, guided, AI-native, and outcome-oriented.

 What You'll Do 

 
 Define the product strategy for Reddit's Developer Ecosystem, including the transition from code-first developers to a broader base of AI-assisted creators.

 Own the roadmap for developers.reddit.com as the primary builder portal, including onboarding, docs, app management, analytics, review status, feature access, education, examples, templates, and AI-assisted creation entry points.

 Lead strategy for AI-assisted app creation, including prompt-to-app workflows, AI building tools, no-code or low-code experiences, reusable templates, generated scaffolds, and systems that help creators turn ideas into useful Reddit-native apps.

 Build the product approach for an App Marketplace that helps users, moderators, communities, and internal teams discover high-quality apps, games, agents, tools, and community experiences.

 Improve app review and ecosystem operations through tooling, automation, and AI-assisted workflows, including LLM-powered app review, policy checks, quality signals, and reviewer efficiency.

 Partner with Engineering to prioritize core platform capabilities and performance improvements such as webhooks, webviews, APIs, SDKs, tooling, observability, and other primitives builders need to create reliable apps.

 Drive more successful, retentive, and popular apps and games by identifying best practices, improving templates, shaping incentives, and creating clearer paths from idea to launch to growth.

 Identify and support new creator and developer categories

 Partner with internal teams such as Contribution, Community Builders, Games, Search, Recommendations, Safety, and Ads to help them launch new functionality through the developer ecosystem.

 Define and improve feature adoption programs so builders understand, test, and successfully use new platform capabilities.

 Work with developer relations to establish the measurement system for the ecosystem, including weekly active developers/creators, NPS/CSAT, app launches, app retention and more

 Create clear frameworks for when Reddit should build platform primitives, launch templates, fund builders, partner with external teams, promote apps, or shut down low-quality or low-trust ecosystem behavior.

jobs.title: Staff Data Scientist - Martech Platform (ML/Algos)
jobs.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. 

 The Community You Will Join: 

 Marketing Data Science Measurement empowers Airbnb to optimize marketing ROI through data-informed decision-making. We lead the way in defining and advancing best practices for measuring and optimizing marketing impact. We collaborate with Marketing, Finance, Engineering, and Product to provide actionable recommendations and tools based on effective, timely, and granular measurements.

 The Difference You Will Make 

 As a Data Scientist working on algorithms on the Marketing Data Science team, you will develop the models and measurement behind Airbnbâs AI-driven marketing system where AI agents run campaigns within guardrails set by marketers. These systems shape how Airbnb acquires, retains, and re-engages its guest and host community across owned and paid channels. Your models will inform targeting, creative and spend across channels, audiences, and time.

 We are seeking a senior technical leader in ML-driven marketing systems to serve as the data science technical lead across these efforts. You will guide the measurement and optimization approaches for these systems, help develop the models that power them, set the scientific bar, and raise the capability of the team and our partners.

 
 Define with Marketing the objectives these systems optimize and the guardrails they operate within, so automated decisions on bids, budgets, audiences, content, and timing target incremental value rather than proxy metrics.

 Lead the measurement strategy for these programs, combining channel, program, and campaign experiment results into a meta-analytic view of incremental impact.

 Define how predictive models and causal measurement work together so budget decisions rest on both.

 Drive large, ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives from problem framing through production.

 Mentor and set technical standards for data scientists across the team.

 
 A Typical Day: 

 
 Identify and prioritize the highest-value modeling and optimization opportunities across marketing, translating ambiguous business problems into multi-quarter scientific roadmaps.

 Partner with Marketing, Finance, Engineering, and Product to align on metrics, methodology, and investment decisions.

 Architect and review models and pipelines for batch and real-time decisions at scale, such as bidding and message selection; stay hands-on where it matters.

 Define how automated decisions are evaluated before and after launch and the evidence a channel needs to move from marketer-approved proposals to autonomous operation.

 Influence senior leadership with clear recommendations that include uncertainty and trade-offs.

 Mentor DS teammates through design reviews, code reviews, and project scoping.

 Use AI and agentic coding to improve the teamâs workflows and velocity.

 
 Your Expertise: 

 
 6+ years of relevant industry experience and a PhD in a quantitative field.

 Track record of building and deploying machine learning models to optimize advertising outcomes that drive automated decisions at scale.

 Experience designing experiments or incrementality measurement (e.g., holdouts, geo tests) for ML-driven decision systems.

 Deep expertise in the ML lifecycle and algorithms: gradient boosted trees, probabilistic and Bayesian approaches, deep learning, optimization.

 Strong fluency in Python and SQL; experience with modern ML and data infrastructure.

 Fluency in marketing economics (CAC, LTV/CAC, payback, ROAS) and how models connect to budget allocation.

 Demonstrated technical leadership: setting direction across teams, mentoring senior and junior DS, and influencing leadership.

 Clear communication with audiences from engineers to executives.

 
 Preferred Expertise: 

 
 Causal ML, uplift modeling, and integrating predictive models with experimentation and incrementality measurement.

 Contextual bandits, reinforcement learning, or other sequential decision methods for bidding, budget pacing, or next-best-action.

 Hands-on experience with paid media platforms (e.g., Amazon, Google Ads, Meta), including value-based bidding and conversion signals, or with lifecycle channels (email, push).

 Marketplace, travel, subscription, or e-commerce domain experience.

 LLM and agentic AI applications in marketing or measurement, including evaluation of agent outputs.

 Publications, patents, or external presentations that show thought leadership in quantitative marketing and related fields.

jobs.description:
PHENOGY AG is a leading innovator of battery energy storage technologies and solutions for the green electrification of the planet. Our team members work on future-proof and sustainable battery systems that are powerful, safe, and robust – with circularity as a central principle. Our technology partner network spans leading battery research institutes. PHENOGY is an environmentally and socially conscious enterprise. We are committed to fostering prosperity for the people and our planet, ensuring sustainable growth – starting in the area of our greatest expertise and impact: energy storage solutions.

We energize the future.

PHENOGY is seeking curious, entrepreneurial-minded energy pioneers to help shape our vision, systems, and growth; playing a key-role as we launch into our ambitious future. If you’re inspired by our mission, values, and drive to change how we energize the future — we’d love your application.

Purpose/Mission - The role owns the infrastructure, network and cybersecurity workstream for

  • PHENOGY's corporate IT infrastructure (cloud, network, endpoints, identities and access) and its interfaces with the Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) product environment. It translates business, product, operational, customer and regulatory requirements into secure, resilient and auditable infrastructure and security controls across the BESS lifecycle.
  • Cybersecurity governance and the Information Security Management System (ISO/IEC 27001)
  • Security architecture of BESS connectivity (EMS, BMS, gateways, IoT, APIs) and secure data exchange with partners such as Heidelberg
  • Backup, business continuity and disaster recovery for critical systems (BESS/EMS, ERP, CRM)
  • Project management of infrastructure and cybersecurity projects

Your Tasks & Responsibilities

  • Act as internal-facing and technical owner of the IT infrastructure and security landscape: network, firewalling and web filtering, Microsoft 365/Azure tenants, identity and access management, endpoints, backup, and secure remote/supplier access to BESS sites.
  • Maintain the asset and configuration inventory, network and security architecture documentation, risk register, vulnerability backlog, security policies and the infrastructure/security roadmap.
  • Run the risk management and vulnerability management cycle: periodic assessments, prioritisation, patching and remediation tracking across IT systems, applications, APIs and BESS connectivity.
  • Define and operate security monitoring, incident response, escalation paths, maintenance windows and problem management, together with external service providers (MSP/MSSP).
  • Define backup and retention policies (daily, monthly, yearly; 10+ years for critical data), offline/immutable backups, disaster-recovery runbooks and regular restore and DR tests.
  • Define secure segmentation between corporate IT and the OT/BESS environment and secure remote access for O&M and field service, aligned with IEC 62443 concepts.
  • Provide infrastructure, system-integration and cybersecurity support to the After Sales & Service framework once operational responsibility moves to the Service Manager.
  • Support B2B customer and audit requests: security questionnaires, tender requirements and compliance evidence.
  • Hands on when required: configure firewall rules, endpoint and identity policies, backup jobs and cloud security settings.

  • Risk Management & Vulnerability Assessment (Jan–Feb 2027): assess risks and vulnerabilities across all systems and deliver a prioritised remediation plan.
  • BESS Security Architecture II (Jan–Mar 2027): secure the BESS architecture and data exchange with Heidelberg, building on the current BESS security baseline.
  • Business Continuity & Recovery System (Feb–Apr 2027): offline backup and disaster recovery for critical systems such as BESS/EMS, ERP and CRM.
  • Network Improvements (Feb–Jun 2027): introduce firewalling and web filtering, which are not yet in place.

  • ISO 27001 Enhancements (ongoing): close control gaps, maintain policies and evidence, and prepare for audits.
  • Take over operation of granular backup and advanced endpoint management, and provide security input to the PHENOGY IoT solution POC (BMS/EMS communication and REST APIs).

jobs.title: Senior Manager Product Structure & Systems (PLM/MES)
jobs.description:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.
 

 The Opportunity 

 As the Senior Manager of Product Structure, PLM & MES, you are the architect of the digital backbone that connects our robotic innovations to real-world production. In this high-impact leadership role, you will strategically own the implementation and evolution of our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and Manufacturing Execution (MES) systems and processes to scale with a rapidly growing product and manufacturing organization ("Digital Thread").
You will govern the product architecture for our complex mechatronic systems, ensuring that our Engineering BOM (EBOM), Manufacturing BOM (MBOM), and Service BOM (SBOM) are perfectly synchronized. 
This is not just a systems role — it’s a business transformation mandate. You will define and execute the PLM and MES roadmap in collaboration with executive stakeholders, ensuring alignment between engineering, operations, product, and after-sales service functions. You’ll help us build an integrated, enterprise-grade ecosystem that accelerates product development, enables traceability, and scales product data excellence.

 

 

 The Market & Our Technology 

 ANYbotics transforms industrial plants in the energy, process, and utility sector by introducing robotics to a wide range of novel applications that so far were beyond reach. Our customers are large asset operators and industrial service providers pioneering the use of robotics technology for inspection and maintenance. Our mobile robot ANYmal uses legs for extreme mobility in complex environments, camera- and LIDAR-based sensing for full autonomy and obstacle avoidance, and AI for high-quality and consistent inspection results. We develop numerous customized hardware systems, including the entire robotic platform, actuators, sensors, inspection payloads, charging systems, and all related ANYbotics mechanical hardware.

 Your Impact 

 Product Structure & Configuration Governance 

 BOM Mastery: Define and govern multi-level BOM structures for complex robotic systems, ensuring alignment across Engineering, Manufacturing, and Service. 

 Modular Architecture: Support platform-based development by managing product configurations, variants, and component reuse strategies. 

 Data Standards: Enforce rigorous part-numbering schemes, revision control, and BOM rules to maintain 100% data integrity. 

 PLM System Ownership & Digital Thread 

 Platform Management: Own the strategic roadmap, implementation and functional administration of the PLM environment (e.g., Windchill, Teamcenter, CIM Database). 

 System Integration: Manage the technical "Digital Thread" between CAD → PLM → ERP → MES, ensuring real-time synchronization of product and manufacturing data. 

 Release Management: Oversee the lifecycle states, access controls, and workflows for all product releases and configuration baselines. 

 MES & Manufacturing Data Integration 

 Production Execution: Ensure the flawless transfer of product structures from PLM to the MES for production execution. 

 Process Definition: Collaborate with Manufacturing Engineering to define production routings, assembly sequences, and digital work instructions in the MES. 

 Traceability: Maintain "As-Built" traceability, ensuring consistency between MES production data and ERP production orders. 

 Engineering Change (ECM) & Continuous Improvement 

 Change Governance: Lead the Engineering Change Request (ECR) and Order (ECO) processes, ensuring controlled propagation of changes across all systems. 

 Optimization: Drive continuous improvement in workflows to reduce NPI (New Product Introduction) cycle times and improve manufacturing scalability. 

 Audit & Compliance: Conduct regular product data audits and implement corrective actions to ensure "Single Source of Truth" reliability. 

 Your Profile 
 

 Master’s degree in Systems Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering

 
 7+ years of experience in Configuration, PLM and MES system management, administration and implementation, ideally in hardware or complex mechatronic product environments

 
 Proven track record leading cross-functional PLM projects with enterprise impact — from roadmap design to hands-on delivery

 
 Strong technical knowledge of PLM architectures (e.g., Teamcenter, Windchill, Arena, CIM Database), MES systems (e.g. Tulip, Opcenter) and their integration with ERP, CAD, and quality systems

 
 Deep understanding of business processes spanning engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and service

 
 Highly effective communicator with the ability to engage and influence at all levels, including senior leadership and management

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager (UK Loans)
jobs.description:
About Zable
 Zable (formerly Lendable) is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money .
 Founded in 2014, profitable since 2017, unicorn since 2021

 The number one issuer of new credit cards and loans in the UK

 Backed by Balderton Capital and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan 

 Loved by customers & our team with top reviews on Glassdoor and Trustpilot

 Zable was founded on the belief that smarter technology is the solution to lower cost, more transparent consumer finance. Our proprietary foundation models analyse thousands of data points in seconds, drawing a more complete picture of individual financial behaviour. This means we can make better risk decisions, widening access and lowering prices.
 The Zable credit card harnesses this technology to deliver better borrowing for three million people. Through our superapp, Zable connects this card to a single platform which makes it effortless to manage credit, get a loan, refinance existing borrowing, switch utilities, get a mobile plan and save more.
 Zable is now the number one issuer of new credit cards and personal loans in the UK, but we’ve barely got started. Next, we’re taking our approach to some of the biggest markets in the world - the US and Mexico - where hundreds of millions of people are underserved by outdated bank processes.
 
 Join us if you want to
 Take ownership across a broad remit - you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Zable from day one

 Work in small teams of exceptional people - who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

 Build the best technology in-house - using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

  
 About the role
 We're looking for a proactive, data-driven Associate Product Manager to join our UK Loans product team. You'll play an important role in shaping the customer experience after they take out a loan: from how we engage with customers and manage payments, to how we support those who experience financial difficulty.
 APMs at Zable take ownership of their product changes, working closely with teams across Engineering, Credit, Finance and Operations to solve problems and take the business to the next level.
 You'll have the opportunity to solve complex problems, scale impactful products, and help shape the future of our lending experience. If you're excited by fintech and enjoy turning data and customer insight into great products, we'd love to hear from you.
 
 What you’ll work on
 Improving repayment performance: Running experiments to help more customers pay on time, from choosing repayment dates to how and when we remind people to pay.

 Personalising customer engagement: Own how we communicate across email, SMS and in-app notifications, testing new messages and improving our tooling.

 Making loan management easier: Optimising and expanding journeys within the Zable SuperApp, particularly for those who need additional financial support.

 Join us if you want to

 Work in small teams of exceptional people - who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

 Build the best technology in-house - using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

  
 About the role 
 Every email and notification we send is part of how customers experience Zable, and a 5.0★ Trustpilot rating across more than 100,000 reviews sets a high bar for it: communication has to be clear, timely and honest. As our Senior Product Manager for CRM & Growth, you'll own the products and systems that shape how customers hear from us across their lifecycle, from first interaction through to retention and reactivation.
 Product here isn't backlog grooming. The trade-offs are commercial as much as they are user-facing: engagement, retention, conversion, cost to serve and customer experience all pull against each other, and you'll make the calls. There will always be more good ideas than capacity, so sharp prioritisation is central to the job. The role also has a real technical edge. Messaging reliability, deliverability and platform integrations are part of what you'll own, so you'll need to be comfortable going deep with engineers. Teams here are small relative to the size of the book we run, so you'll carry more scope and ownership than the same title would at a larger, more layered company.

 What you'll be doing 
 Owning the roadmap and outcomes for our CRM and lifecycle product: onboarding, engagement, retention and reactivation

 Prioritising a pipeline of competing opportunities across CRM, growth, deliverability and platform work, weighing expected impact, effort and risk, and being clear about what we won't do

 Taking products and channel improvements from problem definition through to launch and iteration, owning both the product and technical decisions alongside Engineering

 Defining the metrics that matter and making the commercial trade-offs between growth, retention, cost and customer experience, and making sure performance is measurable end to end, from tracking and data flows through to dashboards the wider business can trust

 Running an experimentation programme: writing clear hypotheses, designing A/B tests, and using SQL and our data to measure true incremental impact

 Treating email deliverability and messaging reliability as product concerns, working with Engineering on infrastructure, platform integrations and cost efficiency

 Shaping requirements with Engineering, Design, Marketing, Risk and Compliance so that what we ship is effective and meets the standards expected of a regulated lender

 Holding a high bar for what customers receive: clear, honest content, well-tested design, and rigorous checks before and after launch.

 What we're looking for 

 Essential 
 5+ years in product management, with substantial experience in CRM, lifecycle, messaging or growth for a consumer product at meaningful scale

 Strong product management fundamentals: you've taken a product or channel from problem definition through launch and iteration, and owned both the product and the technical sides of delivery

 Excellent prioritisation: a clear, defensible way of ranking competing opportunities by expected impact, effort and risk, the confidence to say no, and the ability to explain trade-offs to stakeholders

 A track record of owning measurable outcomes in engagement, retention or revenue, not just ship

 About the role 
 We're building a larger, dedicated Platform team at Zable, increasing our investment in the infrastructure that enables our products and engineering teams to scale.
 We're hiring a Technical Product Manager to sit within Engineering and connect platform technology, reliability and commercial value. You'll own what we prioritise and why, giving engineers the business context they need while helping Product and leadership understand the impact and opportunities that Platform enables.
 This is a hands-on technical IC role, where you'll stay close to engineering through writing code, reviewing PRs and contributing to architecture discussions.
 Working closely with the Platform Engineering Manager and Tech Lead, you'll help shape the Platform roadmap, connect technical investment to measurable business outcomes, and build the foundations that allow Zable to move faster and scale with confidence.
 
 What you'll be doing 
 Own platform stability 
 Own platform stability as a primary accountability - SLA/SLO metrics, incident rates, release quality.

 Hold release gating authority: block features from production that don't meet testing standards or introduce unacceptable regression risk.

 Enforce CI/CD standards centrally so pods don't fragment into one-off solutions.

 Track and report stability metrics alongside commercial outcomes - stability is the foundation that makes the rest possible.

 Be commercially accountable 
 Own the business case for platform investment and answer "why are we spending six engineers on this for three months?" in terms leadership understands.

 Track platform impact in business terms: developer velocity, incident cost, time-to-market, reliability, capacity - e.g. "CXO rollout removes a 3-second API fan-out, reducing session abandonment" or "we can now handle 20k simultaneous logins".

 Input into headcount and investment decisions for the platform team.

 Own the platform roadmap 
 Own the platform backlog, prioritised by business value and sequenced to unblock the highest-value product teams first - not driven by technical debt or engineer preference alone.

 Make trade-offs explicit: "if we do X now, we defer Y by Z weeks - here's what that means for products depending on us".

 Ensure every initiative has a defined success metric that non-engineers can track.

jobs.description:
About lemon.markets 🍋
 We grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses, providing seamless access to capital markets. We enable everyone to be an investor.
 lemon.markets builds infrastructure for financial services and technology companies powering the next generation of investment products. From enabling a FinTech to launch their first investment product, over allowing e.g. a Neobank to embed investing into their product to bringing investing into a completely new context. Our API-first infrastructure makes launching an investment product customer-centric and compliant. We abstract all complexity for our partners through a well documented API, a self-service customer operations portal and operating in a clear regulatory framework. Enabling partners to launch in weeks, not months.
 We have experienced first hand that brokerage infrastructure is broken. Building an investment product used to be highly expensive, challenging and cumbersome. We ease this pain by shielding our partners & their customers from the underlying complexity - and with that we make investing more accessible to everyone. Because that’s exactly what we enjoy, going to places nobody else dares and solving hard problems. This not only creates tons of value when done right, but attracts the smartest minds - because outlier companies are built by exceptional (& diverse) people like you.
 
 Your Mission: 
 As Senior Product Manager, Investing, you own this domain end to end. You set its strategy and roadmap, run discovery and delivery, and answer for its outcomes. You represent the domain to some of the biggest financial institutions in Europe and to our dwpbank counterparts, and you are the go-to person internally, collaborating where it moves us forward and holding the line where it matters.
 Reporting to the Head of Product, you lead the domain's product work. The remit is large, strategically and in delivery, and it grows as the domain grows. Success looks like partners shipping compliant products on our infrastructure without us being the bottleneck.
 
 You will: 
 Own the Investing product domain and its outcomes, from problem framing through to launch, adoption, and iteration

 Run product discovery and delivery inside a cross-functional crew with operations and engineering

 Shape and drive the strategy and roadmap for the entire domain: order flow, execution, trading mechanics, tax, corporate actions, and the instrument universe

 Act as the domain go-to person and go-to expert for everything that happens before and after an order

 Engage directly with enterprise partners and prospects: scope requirements, negotiate delivery, prioritise

 Partner with risk, finance, and compliance so that what we build is compliant by design

 Work across other product teams and solutions engineering to keep partner-specific integrations sustainable on our platform
 

 You will be successful in this role if: 
 You have at least four years of product experience and have independently shipped complex products from problem definition through launch and iteration.

 You have strong product craft , combining customer insight, business thinking and technical understanding to make sound product decisions.

 You use AI tools in your day-to-day work and are comfortable experimenting with them, challenging their limitations and finding practical ways to improve your output.

 You are comfortable with ambiguity , bringing structure to unclear problem spaces and making confident decisions before every answer is available.

 You use data and evidence to guide your decisions , while remaining open to changing your position when new information emerges.

 You build trust across Engineering, Compliance and enterprise partnerships , communicate clearly in writing and bring the energy to challenge assumptions and move people forward.

 You thrive on ownership. You are intrinsically motivated to create impact by delivering high quality outcomes for our customers by taking initiative and challenging the status quo.

 You have a collaborative mindset . Working together as a team and sharing knowledge comes natural to you. While you will have a lot of autonomy delivering your projects, you understand the necessity of cross-functional work, a certain pragmatism & dedication to our mission.

 You are a great communicator in English and German . . Working in a start-up can be messy & unstructured at times, you’re able to sift through the noise, and assess what's really critical. You create buy-in for your plans from your stakeholders by applying a strong writing culture.
