jobs.title: Senior Implementation Project Manager
jobs.description:
We’re Making Travel Effortless. Join Us. 
 Travel is essential, whether it’s visiting family, starting a new adventure, or taking a career defining trip. Yet today, over 4 billion airline passengers rely on tech that hasn't changed in decades.
 At Duffel, we’re rebuilding the infrastructure underpinning the global travel industry. Backed by top-tier investors (Benchmark, Blossom, Index Ventures, and Kima Ventures) and born out of Y Combinator (S18), we’re simplifying complex systems to build the future of travel.
 
 Customer Success at Duffel 
 Customer Success owns Duffel's relationship with our customers once the contract is signed. We help them integrate, launch and grow on Duffel across Flights, Stays and more. The team brings together Customer Success Managers, Customer Success Engineers and Technical Support Engineers across London and New York, led by our VP, Customer Success. We're growing the team and building the processes that help customers go live faster and get more from Duffel.
 
 The Role 
 We're hiring a Senior Project Implementation Manager to own every new customer's journey from signed contract to a live, transacting integration. This is a new, senior individual contributor role reporting to the VP, Customer Success, with a direct line of sight to the leadership team.
 You'll run each onboarding as a project with a plan, a date and named owners, working with our Solutions Engineer so customers go live on time and with the right setup for their proposition. You'll also hold the view across every onboarding in flight, give the leadership team a clear, regular read on progress and risk, and work with internal teams to remove friction, automate manual steps and shorten the time it takes customers to go live.
 Our customers include some of the largest fintech and software platforms in the world, building flights, stays and more on top of Duffel's API. Most of our transaction volume is in the US, so you'll work closely with US-based customer teams from London.
 
 What You’ll be doing: 
 Own each onboarding end to end: take the handover from Sales at contract signature, run a structured kick-off, and lead the customer through to go-live and their first live bookings.

 Build and run a project plan for every onboarding, covering commercial setup, API integration milestones, payments and finance setup, testing and launch, and be the customer's single point of contact for status.

 Pull in the right people across Sales, Implementation, Customer Success, Engineering, Payments, Finance and Travel Operations, spot blockers early, and escalate when a date slips.

 Keep one source of truth for every onboarding in flight, prioritise across them, and report weekly to the VP, Customer Success and monthly to the leadership team.

 Build a repeatable onboarding playbook, track time-to-live, on-time go-live rate and time to first transaction, and feed recurring friction back to Product and Engineering.

 What we're looking for: 
 5+ years running customer onboarding, implementation or technical project delivery in B2B SaaS, fintech, payments or another API-first business, with a track record of getting several complex onboardings live on time at once.

 Enough technical fluency to follow API-led integrations (REST APIs, webhooks, sandbox vs production, test plans) and hold your own with engineers. You don't need to write code.

 Confidence with senior customer stakeholders, and calm, direct escalation: you raise a slipping date early, with a proposed fix and a named owner.

 Experience building process where little exists, such as a playbook, tracker or reporting cadence, and getting other teams to adopt it, plus clear written status reports a leadership team can read in two minutes.

 Willingness to work regular US-overlap hours. Experience in travel tech, onboarding enterprise platforms that embed a third-party API, or being the first person in a new function is a bonus.

 What you'll be working on 
 In your first 30 days: getting to know every onboarding in flight, who's involved and where each one is stuck, with a single tracker in place and a first status report to leadership.

 By 90 days: every new customer gets a kick-off, a project plan and a committed go-live date, a v1 onboarding playbook is in use, and baseline time-to-live is measured.

 Designing the onboarding model by segment, from white-glove onboarding for large platforms to a lighter, scalable path for smaller accounts.

 In your first year: time-to-live measurably shorter, most onboardings going live on the date agreed at kick-off, and a playbook solid enough to hand to the next hire into the team.

 Why You’ll Love Working at Duffel 
 We believe in true ownership. That’s why every permanent employee gets equity in the business.
 Perks That Actually Matter: 
 ✈️ Travel Allowance: We literally pay you to get out of town and explore the world.
 🏝️ Work From Anywhere: Flexibility is built in. Work remotely, or take advantage of our Sabbatic

jobs.title: Clinical Project Manager / Senior Clinical Project Manager
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced full service Project Manager in the field of clinical trials who’s engaged in addressing the challenges facing the research and development of novel compounds in Oncology. Are you passionate about impacting the health and lives of patients around the world? Do you take a consultative approach to trial management, proving to be a valuable partner in trial operational delivery?

Precision for Medicine are looking to hire a Clinical Project Manager / Senior Clinical Project Manager with experience in Oncology who have managed full service clinical trials within a CRO setting to join our global team.

In this pivotal role you will have full service oversight for clinical projects across global/regional (ph I-IV) trials, within Oncology.  Accountable for clinical project delivery, oversight of all functional departments, and ensuring agreed timelines, scope, cost and quality.

Involved in all study stages, including proposal strategy, development, costing, and bid defence, and seeing studies through the full cycle to completion, managing the client relationship, project team and budget and timelines throughout.

You will work in a cross-functional team with both internal and external stakeholders, driving quality and coordinating the study team.

We offer an amazing high-energy, dedicated, collaborative team members who enjoy a challenge, thrive in the details and flourish in dynamic environments. If you are no stranger to taking charge and seek positive teamwork to deliver extraordinary work, we have an opportunity for you.

How we will keep you busy and support your growth:

  • You will independently lead clinical projects in accordance with the study budget and scope of work. You will use your strong interpersonal and organizational skills to set and achieve objectives in the execution of the projects; both contracted objectives and financial objectives. You may be called upon to run international trials as well.
  • Serve as the primary point-of-contact liaison with the client to provide excellent customer service, including participation in proposal activities and client presentations
  • Liaise with Project Team and senior management of both Precision and sponsors, including C level
  • Handle and lead all aspects of a clinical research trial or trials
  • Total project management for all functional areas including data management, safety, clinical, medical monitoring and biostatistics, etc.
  • Prepare project status updates for clients and management; identifying key deliverables and performance metrics of success and escalation.
  • Serve as an active member of the Project Team with the goal to contribute towards efficient management and execution of trials
  • Prepare and reviews protocols and other study documentation such as project plans, inform consents, site contracts and budgets

Requirements:

  • Degree or similar related life science qualification, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Previous experience in a full service/global Project Management role working in the CRO industry is essential.
  • Extensive experience working within Clinical Operations position within a CRO, and at least 4 years full service Project Management experience in a clinical trial setting working for a Clinical Research Organisation.
    • Experience managing studies within Oncology 
    • Working understanding of GCP/ICH guidelines and the clinical development process
  • Ability to drive and availability for domestic and international travel including overnight stays
  • Be able to communicate effectively in the English language both written and spoken
  • Strong presentation skills
  • Proven computer skills (MS Office, MS Project, PowerPoint) and software experience (CTMS, eTMF, EDC, IXRS)
  • Proven ability to develop positive working relationships with individual and teams internally and externally
  • Demonstrated core understanding of medical terminology and clinical trial activities as it relates to the execution of a clinical development plan

Precision for Medicine's uniquely integrated offering enables the science of precision medicine by combining novel clinical trial designs, industry-leading operational and medical authorities, advanced biomarker and data analytics solutions, and an unequivocal real passion for rare diseases and oncology.

We are a people focussed CRO with a supportive and collaborative environment which promotes work life balance and encourages team development. 

We invite you to learn more about our growing organization serving our clients that are researching ground-breaking cancer therapies. We strive to ensure employees feel appreciated for the contributions they make every single day.

jobs.title: Sr. MarTech Specialist, Attribution & Performance
jobs.description:
Building the Future of Open Finance 

 Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.
 
 The team 
 Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.
 Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.
  
 The opportunity 
 As a Sr. MarTech Specialist for Attribution and Performance, you will support attribution and performance measurement at Payward by owning the data and processes that keep it accurate, and by acting as the bridge between our engineers and our performance marketing team. You will form part of a wider MarTech team and partner closely with finance and compliance so that measurement stays accurate and follows our safety and compliance practices. You will also use AI as a core part of how you work, moving quickly and sharing what you learn with the team. Key responsibilities include:
 Attribution: 
 Drive attribution across web and app, covering conversion definitions, touchpoint credit and journeys stitched together across 3rd party vendors and our inhouse data platforms.

 Reconcile ad platform, MMP, analytics and internal numbers, and explain the gaps in plain language.

 Investigate discrepancies caused by vendor configuration, attribution methodology, fraud or bugs in our own apps.

 Use AI as part of your everyday workflow to speed up investigation, SQL, specs and reporting, share what works with the team and contribute to team Agent.

 Contribute to the roadmap for the next level of attribution, such as incrementality testing, LTV-based optimisation and marketing mix modelling.

 Engineering partnership: 
 Turn performance marketing needs into clear specs and tickets for engineering, covering event design, deep links, SDK changes and server-side tracking, and review what ships.

 Work with engineers and data owners to keep the signals ad platforms optimise on (Meta, Google and TikTok conversion APIs and postbacks) complete, deduplicated and consent-compliant.

 Audit and standardise event naming, properties and volume, with monitoring in place to catch breakages early.

 Performance and cross-functional support: 
 Run a regular rhythm with performance marketing on attribution health, discrepancies and test readouts.

 Put a measurement plan in place before spend goes live on new channels, launches and tests, and own the readout afterwards.

 Support weekly and monthly reporting cycles, maintain the attribution dashboards the performance team relies on, and support spend and invoice reconciliation with finance.

 Work directly with MMP and ad platform reps and vendor support, escalating with evidence.

 Work with compliance to keep tracking, conversion signals and reporting aligned with Payward's safety and compliance practices, including consent, privacy (GDPR, CCPA) and financial promotion rules.

 Set up monitoring and alerts for tracking breakages, fraud and volatility-driven spikes in traffic and conversions, such as sharp market moves, and escalate per policy.

 Participate in cross-functional discussions with product, compliance, finance, design, data and performance marketing, and prioritise requests openly.

 
  
 What you bring 
 5+ years of experience in MarTech, performance marketing technology, growth analytics or a related digital marketing field.

 Hands-on experience with web and mobile attribution, including MMPs (such as AppsFlyer or Branch), SKAN, deep linking and web-to-app journeys.

 Understanding of why ad platforms credit conversions differently, and experience with conversion APIs and server-side tracking for Meta, Google Ads and TikTok.

 Comfortable working with data: SQL and a data warehouse, able to read an event schema and trace a discrepancy back to its source.

 An AI-native way of working: you already use AI assistants and agents day to day for analysis, SQL, scripting, documentation and automation, move fast with them, check their output before relying on it, and follow our data privacy and security rules when doing so.

 Experience working within safety and compliance practices in a regulated environment, such as consent and financial promotion rules, and monitoring data and alerts through volatile periods when traffic and conversions swing quickly.

 Strong stakeholder management and written communication skills,

jobs.title: (Mid-Senior) Project Manager - Workday Optimization & HR Transformation (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.  

 You will join Flix's People & Organization in the Digital Transformation team to lead our HRIS transformation programme to optimize our processes, revamp payroll ecosystem and define the target operating model for a human-led, AI-partnered and agent-operated People function. 

 As (Senior) Project Manager (m/f/d), you will bring structure to a large, fast-moving transformation across various workstreams. You will turn ambition into a plan, a decision framework and a delivery rhythm that HR, our internal Workday technology team and external partners can all follow. 

 The role reports to the Head of Digital Transformation, and will work closely with People Operations, People Partners, Centres of Expertise and Tech teams. 

 This role is based in Berlin , with a minimum office presence of 3 days per week. 
 

 About the Role 

 
 Lead HRIS transformation , owning the integrated plan, milestones, dependencies and RAID log across the HRIS revamp, payroll transition and operating-model workstreams, and keeping all our functional and tech teams working as one delivery engine 

 Set up project governance and decision frameworks , including master data ownership, DACI/RACI and decision rights, intake and prioritization, escalation paths and steering forums 

 Plan and facilitate process revamp workshops with our process owners, People Partners and CoEs, driving as-is/to-be gap analysis, global-first standardization with justified local variants, and clear process ownership across the hire-to-retire lifecycle 

 Translate business needs into technical requirements , working with our HRIS tech team, user stories, acceptance criteria, testing and UAT, release readiness and documentation 

 Steer a complex global payroll transformation including middleware solutions, integrations, parallel runs, sign-offs and cut-over, and building a repeatable migration playbook 

 Manage stakeholders and drive proactive change management with transparent reporting, risk escalation, adoption metrics and a calm, structured presence when priorities shift
 

 
 About You 

 
 7+ years of experience managing complex, multi-country transformation programmes in HR technology, with a track record of delivering in a global-local environment 

 Proven experience in Workday transformation projects, such as optimization, business process redesign or platform revamps, with enough technical fluency to challenge and align with configuration, security and integration teams. Workday certifications are an advantage 

 Hands-on experience in payroll transformation , such as vendor migrations, country roll-outs, parallel runs and cut-over planning. Experience with global payroll providers is a strong plus 

 Experience shaping target operating models and governance frameworks , including service delivery models, master data governance, DACI/RACI and decision-rights design 

 Strong workshop and process-revamp skills, with the ability to facilitate cross-functional groups, map as-is/to-be processes (e.g. BPMN) and reach decisions without losing momentum 

 Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including influencing senior leaders, translating between business and technical teams, and staying calm and building structure in ambiguity. Familiarity with works council and multi-country compliance requirements is a plus 

 Strong hands-on knowledge of Jira and Confluence . Certifications in project management or agile delivery (e.g. PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, Scrum) are a plus.
 

 
 We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!  

 What We Offer

 Wellbeing support : Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. 

 Learning & Development : Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. 

 Mentoring Program : Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career.

 Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?
 Are our Product Principles aligned with your vision?
 Then Pennylane is the right place for you !
  
 Our vision 
 We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).
 We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.
  
 About us 
 Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

 💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
About SANOVIO
 SANOVIO is the collaborative AI platform for healthcare procurement. Every euro a hospital loses in purchasing is missing in patient care. We help hospitals get good products at fair prices, with far less manual work.
 We build the software. And we move the goods. SANOVIO aOS, our agentic operating system for procurement, handles master data management, portfolio management and digital procurement processing. SANOVIO Fulfillment covers global direct sourcing, quality control, warehousing and logistics.
 Founded in 2024 in Munich by Noel Nosswitz, Alexander Hüttner and Yong Wang, we work with hospitals in Germany and Switzerland, purchasing groups and international suppliers. We are customer-funded: our customers are our only investors.
 The role
 As Technical Product Manager, you turn real procurement problems into working software. You sit between our hospital and supplier users, our engineering team and the founders. You decide what we build next, shape how it works, and often build the first version yourself.
 You work on SANOVIO aOS and the internal tools behind our fulfillment operations: AI agents that clean item master data, workflows that move an order from request to ward, and integrations with hospital and supplier systems.
 A large part of the role is talking to customers. You join calls and on-site visits with hospital purchasing teams, purchasing groups and suppliers, show them what we build, take their feedback and turn it into product decisions. You are a trusted contact for our customers on everything technical.
 Location: Munich (on-site, with flexibility).
 What you will do
 Own the product roadmap for selected areas of SANOVIO aOS, from problem discovery to release.

 Be in close, regular contact with customers: hospital buyers, purchasing groups and suppliers, plus our own operations team, to understand how procurement works in practice.

 Lead the implementation of SANOVIO aOS at customers: from setup and data onboarding to go-live.

 Own product education: run trainings and onboarding for customers and our internal teams, and create guides and demos.

 Write clear product specifications and translate them into tasks engineering can ship.

 Understand and map user flows end to end, and find where users lose time or get stuck.

 Iterate fast: ship a first version, learn from real users and improve it within days, not months.

 Design and prototype AI agents and LLM-based features, for example matching products across supplier catalogues or checking certificates.

 Automate internal workflows across procurement, quality, warehousing and finance, and connect the systems behind them.

 Define how we measure success for each feature and follow up after launch.

 Make sure what we build is secure, reliable and handles confidential hospital and supplier data with care.

 Technical Skills
 Strong software engineering fundamentals, including practical experience with Python, APIs, databases and modern development tools.

 Hands-on experience developing AI-powered applications using large language models, AI agents and related technologies.

 Experience implementing workflow automation and integrating different software systems and data sources.

 Understanding of software architecture, data processing, deployment and the development of reliable, maintainable applications.

 Familiarity with information security, access management and the responsible handling of confidential data.

 Experience with modern AI-assisted development tools and an interest in continuously expanding your technical expertise.

 What else you bring
 A degree in computer science, engineering, business informatics or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 Graduates are welcome, as are candidates with 1 to 2 years of work experience.

 A background in consulting (for example strategy, tech or operations consulting) and a strong pull towards AI: you build with LLMs and agents yourself, not only in slides.

 Experience in product development: you have taken a product or internal tool from first idea to something people use every day.

 Experience in customer-facing work: you enjoy presenting to customers, running workshops and explaining a technical decision to a hospital buyer as clearly as a business problem to an engineer.

 You take ownership, work in a structured way and are comfortable when things are not yet defined.

 You are AI-native: you use AI tools every day and follow what is new in the field.

 You care about healthcare and want your work to have a visible effect on patient care.

 Fluent English and German at C1 level or higher, as many of our customers work in German.

 What we offer
 A real problem with a direct effect on patient care.

 AI that acts: you ship agents that do real work in procurement, not demos.

jobs.description:
Über EVEREST
 EVEREST ist Ideengeber und Projektentwickler für digitale Tools, die Gründer*innen und Kleinunternehmer*innen Zugang zu wirtschaftlichem Know-how, Kapital und Ressourcen ermöglichen. Wir entwickeln Empowerment-Plattformen von der Konzeption bis zum Betrieb – z.B. die kostenlose bundesweite Gründerplattform oder das digitale Beratungsprogramm InStart für Soloselbstständige und Kleinunternehmen in der Krise in Hamburg. Deren Nutzer*innen haben Zugang zu ständig aktualisiertem Wissen, können ihre eigenen unternehmerischen Pläne umsetzen, wichtige Kontakte knüpfen und als Community voneinander profitieren.
 Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams am Standort Hamburg-Altstadt suchen wir dich in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit für eine befristete Position als: 
 
 Senior Product Owner (m/w/d) – Digitale Startup-Plattform
 
 Das erwartet dich
 Eine gute digitale Anwendung macht komplizierte Dinge einfach. Genau daran arbeitest du bei uns.
 Wir entwickeln ein neues digitales Plattformprojekt rund um die Themen Gründung und Startups. Dahinter stehen verschiedene Teilprojekte, komplexe fachliche Anforderungen und viele Ideen, die sinnvoll miteinander verbunden werden müssen.
 Als Senior Product Owner sorgst du dafür, dass aus diesen Ideen ein durchdachtes, technisch realisierbares und vor allem nutzerfreundliches Produkt entsteht.
 Du arbeitest eng mit der Geschäftsführung, Projektleitung und unserem Entwicklungsteam zusammen. Dabei erwarten wir, dass du Entscheidungen fachlich hinterfragst, Abhängigkeiten erkennst und eigene Lösungsvorschläge einbringst.
 
Deine Aufgaben
 Produktentwicklung steuern: Du behältst die verschiedenen Teilprojekte im Blick, erkennst Abhängigkeiten und sorgst dafür, dass Funktionen in einer sinnvollen Reihenfolge entwickelt werden.

 Entscheidungen fundiert vorbereiten: Du prüfst Ideen und Anforderungen auf Nutzen, Logik und technische Machbarkeit. Wenn ein geplanter Entwicklungsschritt noch nicht sinnvoll ist, erklärst du, warum das so ist, und zeigst Alternativen auf.

 Komplexität für Nutzer*innen reduzieren: Du übersetzt komplexes Expertenwissen rund um Gründungsprozesse in einfache, intuitive digitale Anwendungen. Dabei berücksichtigst du die unterschiedlichen Bedürfnisse und Herausforderungen von Gründerinnen – von der ersten Geschäftsidee über die Gründung bis hin zum Wachstum. Dein Anspruch: Nutzerinnen finden in jeder Phase die passende Unterstützung, ohne selbst Expert*innen sein zu müssen.

 Nutzererlebnisse konzipieren: Du entwickelst mit Figma eigenständig User Flows, Wireframes und interaktive Prototypen, überprüfst Konzepte anhand von Nutzerfeedback und optimierst sie gemeinsam mit dem Team.

 Entwicklung konkret voranbringen: Du übersetzt Anforderungen in verständliche User Stories und Entwicklungstickets, priorisierst das Product Backlog und klärst fachliche Fragen direkt mit dem Entwicklungsteam.

 Roadmap und Qualität im Blick behalten: Gemeinsam mit Geschäftsführung und Projektleitung planst du realistische Entwicklungsschritte, begleitest neue Funktionen bis zum Go-live und nutzt Feedback und KPIs für die weitere Optimierung.

 
 Das bringst du mit
 Du hast bereits digitale Produkte entwickelt und weißt aus Erfahrung, dass eine gute Idee allein noch kein gutes Produkt ergibt.
 Erfahrung im Produktmanagement : Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner oder Product Manager mit und hast digitale Produkte bereits eigenverantwortlich von der Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung begleitet.

 Technisches Verständnis: Du kannst Anforderungen mit Entwickler*innen auf Augenhöhe besprechen, technische Abhängigkeiten nachvollziehen und daraus praktikable Lösungen ableiten. Erfahrung mit Low-Code-Plattformen ist ein Plus.

 Sehr gute Figma-Kenntnisse: Du kannst selbstständig interaktive Prototypen entwickeln und hast ein fundiertes Verständnis von UX/UI und nutzerzentrierter Produktentwicklung.

 Analytisches und strukturiertes Denken: Du erkennst frühzeitig, wenn Anforderungen nicht zusammenpassen, technische Voraussetzungen fehlen oder Prioritäten angepasst werden müssen.

 Eigenständigkeit und Kommunikationsstärke : Du vertrittst deine fachliche Einschätzung klar und nachvollziehbar und behältst bei mehreren parallelen Themen den Überblick.

 Agile Produktentwicklung : Du bist vertraut mit Scrum, Backlog-Management und Tools wie Asana. Du kennst außerdem Möglichkeiten, KI sinnvoll in digitalen Produkten und Prozessen einzusetzen.

 Fundiertes Startup-Verständnis : Du verstehst den Lebenszyklus eines Startups – von der ersten Idee über die Gründung und den Markteintritt bis hin zu Wachstum und Skalierung. Du weißt, dass jede Phase unterschiedliche Herausforderungen mit sich bringt, und kannst dich schnell in die jeweiligen Bedürfnisse und Fragestellungen von Gründer*innen hineindenken. jobs.title: Technical Product Manager – Local Control System
jobs.description:
Role
 You’ll build our in-house local control system from scratch: the on-site controller hardware and the software that decides how each battery charges and discharges. You own the product across hardware and software, from the first design to a reliable system running across our fleet.
  
 What you will do
 You will work with a dedicated developer team, and closely with our data scientists and Operations team. Your responsibilities will be:
 Define the local control software, including dispatch logic, control strategies, fallbacks and interfaces to batteries, meters and the central platform.

 Enable our Operations team to bring new sites live through tooling, documentation and hands-on support.

 Own the product backlog, prioritize requirements across Operations, grid operations and the central platform, and work with developers from specification through release.

 Design a configuration schema that works across all sites without requiring site-specific logic.

 Own field reliability, including edge device requirements, testing, safety, release management and fleet-wide updates.

 Drive the integration of power plant controllers and protection devices, and own IT security and the software requirements for grid services prequalification.

  
 What we are looking for
 Experience with software that controls physical systems and being in a product role, ideally in energy (battery storage, PV, inverters, SCADA or similar). Having taken a product from zero to one is a strong plus.

 A strong technical background, typically in electrical engineering, computer science or a related field.

 Experience working with developers as a product owner: writing specifications, setting priorities, etc.

 You understand how batteries, meters and grid connections work in practice and can discuss interfaces and protocols with engineers.

 You think in failure modes and safe states, not just the happy path.

 Fluent in English. German is a plus, as you will work with grid operators and partners in Germany.

 Nice to have: German grid codes and standards, IT security for operational technology, prequalification for balancing services, or experience rolling out software to many distributed devices (e.g. IoT or OTA updates).

  
 What it means to work at BEO
 We are a small team taking on a hard problem, and we hold ourselves to a high bar. We value ownership, direct and honest communication, and getting better every day. If you like solving complex problems, you'll fit right in.

 Our office is in central Munich. We offer plenty of flexibility but ask for an office-first commitment. People learn faster and get more done together.

 We offer a competitive salary, equity upside in the company, and top-notch equipment (you choose what you need).

 You'll join us early in our journey. The foundations are in place, but it's still essentially day one, with plenty of opportunity to shape how we tackle one of the most significant challenges of our time.

  
 Next steps
 We move fast. Most processes are completed within 2 weeks. Apply if this sounds like you.

 On fait du Product et de l’IA depuis 2016, et rien d’autre. Autour de toi, tout le monde parle produit

 Tu as déjà fait de la discovery avec de vrais utilisateurs, et tu as envie d’en faire plus

 Tu aimes convaincre, et défendre une décision face à un client ne te fait pas peur

jobs.title: Product Manager F/H
jobs.description:
Aujourd'hui, une IA sait remplir un backlog.
 Rédiger des user stories, synthétiser des entretiens, proposer une priorisation : la production devient une commodité. Ce qui ne l'est pas : décider de ce qui mérite d'être construit, puis fédérer une organisation autour de cette décision.
 C'est ce métier que tu exerces chez Hubvisory. Tu interviens auprès de grands comptes comme Club Med, SNCF, TF1 ou Saint-Gobain, sur des produits où les arbitrages sont structurants. Tu n'exécutes pas un brief : tu le challenges.
 
 Tes missions 
 Identifier ce qui crée de la valeur. Entretiens utilisateurs, JTBD, story mapping. Tu pars d'hypothèses et tu construis des preuves.

 Arbitrer. Roadmap, OKR, priorisation : tu tranches entre enjeux business, usages et contraintes tech, et tu assumes tes choix face à des interlocuteurs exigeants.

 Piloter le delivery. Backlog, rituels, environnement agile. Tu tiens le rôle de PM en autonomie et tu challenges les pratiques de la squad.

 Mesurer ton impact et défendre tes décisions. Tu définis les indicateurs, tu suis les résultats de tes choix et tu les portes devant les parties prenantes.

 Faire de l'IA un levier. Tu l'utilises pour gagner en efficacité, en gardant la maîtrise de ton jugement.
 

 Notre objectif : faire de toi un PM reconnu pour sa capacité à décider en contexte d'incertitude. Selon ton appétence, ton évolution se construit vers Senior, Product Leader, Manager ou Principal.
 
 Pourquoi rejoindre Hubvisory 
 Une rémunération lisible. De 46 à 58 K€ selon ton expérience, une part variable et l'intéressement jusqu'à 22% des profits, redistribué de façon égalitaire.

 Un rôle sur le quoi, pas seulement sur le comment. Notre positionnement Product & IA nous place là où se crée la valeur.

 Une progression alignée sur ton impact. Revalorisations salariales bi-annuelles, passages de grade fondés sur la performance et non sur l'ancienneté.

 Un onboarding structuré. Un parcours collectif et individuel, avec un plan de formation et une montée en charge progressive. Tu es accompagné par un buddy et un mentor dédiés, et tu as accès à 1000h de contenu à la carte.

 Une taille humaine. Avec 135+ consultants, chacun est identifié, écouté et accompagné.

 
 Le profil recherché 
 3 à 5 ans d'expérience comme PM / PO sur des produits digitaux. Une expérience en conseil ou en grand groupe est un vrai plus.

 Indispensables : maîtrise de la Discovery et du Delivery, capacité à avancer sans cadrage parfait, culture de la mesure d'impact.

 Atouts : usage concret de l'IA dans ta pratique produit, culture SAFe ou agilité à l'échelle.

 Savoir-être : autonomie, posture client solide, engagement dans le collectif (chez Hubvisory, tu t’impliques à la fois chez client et au sein du cabinet).
 

 Le process de recrutement 
 Échange avec un RH : ton projet, notre modèle, tes attentes (45 min)

 Cas pratique avec un Manager : hard skills, en live (90 min)

 Projection stratégique avec un VP ou un cofondateur : posture et vision (90 min)

 Échange de closing avec un RH (15 min)

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - ASRS
jobs.description:
Chez Exotec , nous mettons l’excellence technologique au service de la redéfinition des relations entre humains et robots. A travers le monde, nos solutions révolutionnent la façon dont nos client·e·s délivrent leurs produits aux personnes consommatrices finales. Nous contribuons au succès des plus grandes marques du commerce et de l’industrie, tout en améliorant les conditions de travail de leurs salarié·e·s.
 Par l’alliance de l’intelligence artificielle et d’un hardware performant, nos robots sont désormais déployés dans le monde entier et leur succès a fait de nous la première licorne industrielle française.
 Rejoindre Exotec, c’est l’opportunité de donner du sens à vos compétences. Grandissez avec nos ExoPeople dans le monde entier pour faire de vos idées, des réalités.
 La révolution robotique portée par Exotec ne fait que commencer, vous en êtes ?

 L’ASRS regroupe la partie robotique du Skypod System. Cette Product Line constitue un élément central de la proposition de valeur d’Exotec et mobilise environ 100 personnes au sein de la R&D.
 En tant que Product Director ASRS, vous définissez la vision, la stratégie et les priorités de cette Product Line. Vous donnez une direction claire aux équipes et travaillez au quotidien avec les fonctions R&D, Operations, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success et les équipes projet afin de faire évoluer une solution industrielle critique, performante et différenciante.
 Missions
 En tant que Product Director ASRS, vos missions consistent à :
 Définir la vision, la stratégie et le positionnement de la Product Line ASRS, en cohérence avec la stratégie globale d’Exotec
 Orienter une organisation R&D d’environ 100 personnes autour de priorités produit claires et partagées
 Définir et piloter la roadmap ASRS, en arbitrant les priorités entre valeur client, performance opérationnelle, différenciation technologique, qualité et capacité de développement
 Comprendre les enjeux des opérations logistiques et les besoins des clients utilisant le Skypod System
 Collecter et analyser les besoins du marché, en lien étroit avec les clients, les équipes commerciales, les équipes projet, le marketing et les intégrateurs
 Identifier les opportunités d’évolution de la robotique
 Garantir la cohérence fonctionnelle de l'ensemble de nos produits, en particulier aux interfaces
 Définir les critères de succès des évolutions produit et suivre leur adoption, leur performance et leur impact opérationnel
 Contribuer au positionnement de l’offre, à la définition de sa proposition de valeur et à son évolution commerciale
 Préparer et accompagner les lancements de produits et de fonctionnalités sur les différents marchés internationaux
 Communiquer la vision, les choix et les évolutions du produit auprès des équipes internes, des clients et des partenaires
 Anticiper les risques, dépendances et contraintes liés à des systèmes industriels complexes, en s'appuyant sur les équipes techniques
 Structurer les processus de décision produit et favoriser une culture de collaboration, de responsabilisation et d’amélioration continue
 
 Profil :
 Vous êtes diplômé·e d’une école d’ingénieur ou d’une formation équivalente
 Vous disposez d’ au moins 10 ans d’expérience en Product Management , idéalement dans un environnement industriel, robotique, logiciel ou technologique complexe
 Vous avez une expérience significative dans la définition d’une vision produit et le pilotage d’une roadmap impliquant plusieurs équipes et parties prenantes
 Vous avez exercé un leadership reconnu dans des organisations matricielles, en donnant une direction claire à des équipes pluridisciplinaires et en créant l’alignement nécessaire à la réussite d’ambitions produit complexes
 Vous êtes à l’aise avec les problématiques mêlant hardware, software, robotique, automatisation et systèmes industriels
 Une expérience dans l’intralogistique, les entrepôts automatisés, les systèmes ASRS, la robotique mobile, le WCS ou le WES constitue un véritable atout
 Vous savez comprendre des sujets techniques complexes et les traduire en décisions produit claires et créatrices de valeur
 Vous êtes centré·e sur le client et appréciez le contact direct avec le terrain, les sites opérationnels et les équipes projet
 Vous possédez un esprit analytique et vous appuyez sur les données pour éclairer vos décisions
 Vous êtes capable d’arbitrer dans un environnement où les enjeux clients, business, techniques et opérationnels peuvent être contradictoires
 Vous disposez d’un excellent relationnel et d’un leadership naturel, vous permettant de fédérer des équipes pluridisciplinaires autour d’une ambition commune

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Financial Statement Suite
jobs.description:
Before a company publishes its annual report, finance teams have to turn financial data into a complete set of statements and disclosures. Balances need to be mapped, figures carried forward and updated, and supporting information brought together into a draft. Auditors then check that the notes match the primary statements, this year reconciles with last year, and every total adds up. Preparing and reviewing those statements takes days of detailed work, and errors can carry through into a published report.
 Today, audit teams rely on Financial Statement Suite (FSS) to read statements, run checks, and show reviewers what it found and where, so they can make the call and stand behind it. The opportunity goes beyond reconciliation: helping auditors and financial professionals review drafts, connect figures to supporting evidence, and manage changes through to sign-off.
 You'll own what FSS becomes across preparation and review cycles. You'll decide what sits on the teams roadmap and define strategy for this high opportunity area working with engineering, design, audit experts and the firms who use FSS every day.
 
 About DataSnipper 
 The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust. 
 We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.
 At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.
 For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.
 And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers . Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.
 If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way. 
  
 
 What impact you will have 
 Own the end-to-end strategy and decisions for our financial statements product, with clear domain ownership

 Lead product direction in a key area with direct and clear business impact

 Reimagine how auditors and financial professionals work, making their workflows more defensible
 

 Why it's an exciting challenge 
 Reviewers are sceptical, and they should be. A finding they can't trace is a finding they check again by hand.

 Statements differ by country, by standard and by firm. FSS has to be right on all of them, not just the ones in front of you this week.

 Firms use FSS when the stakes are highest. Every change has to make their next busy season better, not riskier.

 Everyone has a request: firms, sales, partners and engineering. You'll decide which ones the evidence supports, and say no to the rest.

 The full FS experience: how a team moves through a draft, from the first finding to sign-off

 Trust in every check: each finding shows what it compared, where the figures came from, and who reviewed it

 Where FSS goes next: which statement types, standards and markets come first, and why

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager - Code Quality
jobs.description:
Position description 

 As Senior Product Manager for code quality, you’ll decide how 7 million developers find problems in their code as AI writes more of it. The gap is large: 96% of developers don’t fully trust AI-generated code, yet only 48% always check it before committing (Sonar State of Code, 2026). With the engineers who build our analyzers, you’ll shape what SonarQube detects across Cloud, Server and IDE, and how teams verify code written by agents. 

 

 
 The team: 

 
 You will join the Code Quality product team, part of Sonar's Product Management group. Each Code Quality PM works with dedicated engineering squads and partners closely with UX, marketing and sales. We value collaboration, kindness and continuous improvement, and we base decisions on data and customer evidence. 

 What will you own: 

 
 
 The strategy and roadmap to develop our language ecosystems, from market research and customer discovery to shipped rules and analyzers.

 
 Decisions on which new languages Sonar should support, and where we should not compete. 

 
 New AI capabilities: how our analysis fits into the workflows of AI coding agents, and how quality gates apply to AI-generated code. 

 
 Day-to-day trade-offs with analyzer engineers, such as rule precision versus noise, and analysis speed. 

 
 Regular contact with developers and customers through calls, our community forum and conferences, and turning what you learn into roadmap decisions. 

 

 What you will do 
 
 You’ll enjoy this role if you care about well-crafted software and like owning a topic end to end.

 

 
 Product vision and roadmap: research, clarify, and prioritize opportunities, and keep the roadmap effective

 
 Customer interaction: engage with users on the product forum, support them, and turn their feedback into opportunities

 
 Domain expertise: develop a deep understanding of code quality and how to help developers write more reliable, maintainable software

 
 Cross-team work: collaborate with other PMs on cross-product features, and align with engineering and UX from problem definition through development

 Experience and qualifications 
 
 Must-haves 

 
 5+ years in technical roles, ideally including hands-on software development. 

 
 3+ years as a product manager on a technical or B2B software product, owning discovery, strategy and roadmap rather than only the backlog, preferably in an agile environment. 

 
 Hands-on use of AI coding assistants or agents in your own work, and an informed view of how they are changing software development. 

 
 Proven ability to lead a topic autonomously from start to finish, making pragmatic decisions amid change, complexity and uncertainty. 

 
 Fluent written and spoken English. 

 Nice to have 

 
 Solid understanding of code quality in at least one programming language or ecosystem. 

 
 Technical understanding of how code scanning and static analysis tools work. 

 
 Experience in developer tools, or contributions to open-source tooling such as linters, compilers or IDE plugins. 

 
 Experience speaking or writing for developer audiences. 

 

 If you meet most of the must-haves and this work interests you, we encourage you to apply even if your background doesn’t match every point. 

 Benefits of Working with Sonar: 

 We encourage usage of our robust time-off allocations with 27 PTO days for our employees based out of the Geneva region, plus additional days based on seniority and circumstances.

 We contribute 60% of the total cost for your pension; 13.5% to 15.5% of your base salary for savings; 2% for risk.

 Generous discretionary Company Growth Bonus, paid annually. 

 Commuting:Sustainable mobility options, including carpooling and the refund of 60% of the annual transportation subscription.

 Global workforce with employees in 20+ countries representing 35+ unique nationalities.

You will agree the scope and ownership of shared execution orchestration and other expanded capabilities with engine, infrastructure, and consuming-product teams. Engine teams retain detection logic; consuming teams retain their product workflows and acceptance criteria; workflow and Quality Gate owners retain publication, policy, and merge decisions.

 Lead product discovery for issue-processing pipelines, including ingestion, normalization, correlation, deduplication, and tracking findings across code changes. Agree contracts for issue identity and state changes with engine and workflow owners, keeping processing separate from publication and policy decisions.

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Optics11 is a fast-growing high-tech company based in Amsterdam, developing advanced fiber optic sensing solutions for the most demanding environments. Our technology detects the earliest signs of failure in critical assets – from high-voltage energy infrastructure to subsea and defense applications – and gives our customers precise, real-time data they can act on. 
 
 As Senior Product Marketing Manager you will build a deep understanding of the end-to-end solutions (hardware and software) across all of Underwater Security (our OptiBarrier and OptiArray product lines and our software platform), and of the markets and customers they serve. You turn that understanding into clear positioning, compelling value propositions and go-to-market plans that help our sales teams win.
 
 Optics11 is in its scale-up phase, and product marketing in Underwater Security is starting from a basic level. You will build the product marketing function from the ground up: you set up the frameworks, processes and tools it needs, while delivering tangible commercial results along the way. You start as an individual contributor, with the opportunity to grow a small product marketing team over time.
 
 You will be part of the Product team in Underwater Security and work closely with our solutions Product Managers for hardware and software, Sales, Business Development, Marketing, Application Engineering, Customer Projects and R&D teams.
 
 No two weeks will look the same. You might analyze a competitor’s new seabed monitoring system, sharpen the value proposition for an anti-submarine warfare (ASW) tender, work on the launch of a new software release, train the sales team on a new product narrative, or help prepare a customer demo for a tradeshow such as UDT or Euronaval. You will own how our products are positioned, launched and sold in the market, support pricing decisions, and make sure your market insights support Optics11 product decision making.
 
 Within your first 6–12 months, you will have evolved the foundations of product marketing in Underwater Security: clearly defined target segments and buyer personas, a positioning and messaging framework per product line, a competitive intelligence baseline, a repeatable launch process and a first sales enablement toolkit. Your work will sharpen our market focus, improve our win rate and help Optics11 scale its solutions commercially in demanding, high-stakes markets. 
 
 Responsibilities:
 Build the product marketing function by setting up the frameworks, processes, templates and tools for positioning, launches, competitive intelligence, sales enablement and product marketing analytics, tracking pipeline contribution and win rates, and scaling them as the organization grows.

 Define target markets and commercialization plans by analyzing market size, trends, buying contexts and customer needs across mission profiles such as anti-submarine warfare (ASW), intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance (ISR) and critical underwater infrastructure (CUI) protection, prioritizing segments and use cases with Product Management and Business Development, and defining go-to-market approaches, channels and partnerships per segment (e.g. with prime contractors and system integrators).

 Lead competitive intelligence and market monitoring by tracking competitors, technologies, programs and tenders, running win/loss analyses, and sharing actionable insights with Product Management to shape strategy, roadmap and business cases.

 Own product positioning, messaging and value propositions by developing clear, differentiated propositions per product line and segment, and translating technical capabilities into operational and commercial value for defense partners and clients.

 Support Product Management on pricing and packaging by providing market, competitor and customer insights for pricing decisions on products and end-to-end solutions, and aligning price positioning with Sales.

 Plan and execute product launches by introducing a launch process scaled to the size of each release, coordinating launch readiness across Product, Sales and Support, and providing product messaging, content and launch input to the Marketing team.

 Enable sales and ensure commercial readiness by creating sales narratives, pitch decks, battlecards, objection handling and training, preparing customer demos, collateral and tender input with Tech Sales & Bid Management and Application Engineering, and supporting Sales, Business Development and Marketing in key opportunities, tenders and trade shows.

 
 
 
 Requirements:
 Master’s degree in marketing, business or engineering.

 5+ years of experience in product marketing for technical B2B or B2G solutions, preferably combining hardware and software (platform) products in defense or another industrial high-tech / high-compliance environment with long, complex sales cycles such as tenders and partner-led sales.

jobs.title: Junior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Introductie 
 Ben jij analytisch sterk, commercieel ingesteld en heb je affiniteit met techniek en productmanagement? Weet jij marktontwikkelingen te vertalen naar kansen voor producten en diensten? En krijg jij energie van het optimaliseren van een productportfolio en het succesvol introduceren van nieuwe producten?
 Bij FAAC Technologies zoeken we een Junior Product Manager die verantwoordelijk wordt voor de positionering en ontwikkeling van ons productportfolio. In deze rol vorm je de verbindende schakel tussen Sales, Marketing, Techniek en de internationale productmanagementteams van FAAC Group. Door marktontwikkelingen te volgen en klantbehoeften te analyseren, zorg je ervoor dat onze producten aansluiten op de behoeften van de markt en de strategische doelstellingen van de organisatie.
 We zoeken iemand die aan het begin van zijn of haar carrière staat en zich verder wil ontwikkelen binnen productmanagement. Of je nu net bent afgestudeerd en klaar bent voor een eerste uitdaging, of al circa 1 tot 3 jaar werkervaring hebt opgedaan: enthousiasme, analytisch vermogen, commerciële interesse en de motivatie om je te ontwikkelen vinden we minstens zo belangrijk als ruime werkervaring.
 In deze veelzijdige hybride functie komen marktinzichten, commerciële analyses en technische kennis samen om onze producten en diensten continu te verbeteren. Je krijgt de ruimte om je kennis en ervaring verder uit te bouwen en te groeien in de rol. Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de Manager Techniek.
 
 Wat ga je doen / Taken en verantwoordelijkheden 
 Als Product Manager ben je verantwoordelijk voor de positionering, ontwikkeling en optimalisatie van het productportfolio van FAAC Technologies. Marktbehoeften en productontwikkelingen vertaal je naar concrete verbeteringen. Daarnaast zorg je ervoor dat productinformatie, prijzen en communicatie actueel en consistent blijven.
 Analyseren van marktontwikkelingen en klantbehoeften om deze te vertalen naar het productaanbod

 Uitvoeren van prijsanalyses en afstemmen van de prijspositionering met internationale productafdelingen

 Volgen van productontwikkelingen en vertalen van relevante innovaties naar kansen voor de organisatie

 Afstemmen van productintroducties en de lancering van nieuwe diensten met betrokken teams binnen FAAC Group

 Begeleiden van processen rondom productintroducties en het uitfaseren van producten

 Analyseren en optimaliseren van het bestaande productportfolio

 Coördineren van technische producttrainingen en in kaart brengen van de opleidingsbehoefte binnen de organisatie

 Leveren van input voor productcommunicatie, waaronder online communicatie en marketingmateriaal

 Bewaken van de kwaliteit, volledigheid en consistentie van productinformatie

 Beheren en actualiseren van artikellijsten, prijslijsten en productdocumentatie

 Zorgen voor toegankelijke en actuele productinformatie voor interne afdelingen en andere betrokkenen

 Samenwerken met Sales, Marketing, Techniek, internationale productmanagementteams en klanten

 Naleven van de geldende HSE-richtlijnen en bijdragen aan een veilige werkomgeving
 

 Wat bieden wij 
 Bij FAAC Technologies werk je in een stabiele, internationaal opererende en technisch gedreven organisatie met een informele werksfeer en veel ruimte voor zelfstandigheid.
 Een salaris tussen € 4.359,45 en € 6.198,54 bruto per maand , afhankelijk van ervaring

 40 vrije dagen (27 vakantiedagen + 13 ADV-dagen)

 Een goede pensioenregeling via PME, het pensioenfonds voor de Metalektro 

 Een veelzijdige hybride functie op het snijvlak van techniek, commercie en productmanagement

 De mogelijkheid om bij te dragen aan de ontwikkeling en positionering van een internationaal productportfolio

 Intensieve samenwerking met verschillende disciplines en internationale teams

 Een professionele werkomgeving met ruimte voor eigen initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling
 

 Over FAAC Technologie 
 FAAC Technologies, onderdeel van de wereldwijd opererende FAAC Group , is dé specialist in toegangsautomatisering. Van automatische deuren en poorten tot slagbomen en parkeersystemen – wij leveren innovatieve en veilige oplossingen. Bij FAAC werk je in een informele, technische en dynamische omgeving waar samenwerking en klantgerichtheid centraal staan.
 De FAAC Group omvat 32 bedrijven in 24 landen , met 18 fabrieken in 15 landen en 3 business units . Dankzij deze internationale schaal ontwikkelen en implementeren wij wereldwijd oplossingen voor personen- en voertuigenverkeer, met een sterke focus op kwaliteit, veiligheid en duurzaamheid.
 
 
 Wie ben jij 
 HBO werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in een commerciële, technische of bedrijfskundige richting.

 Aan het begin van de carrière, met de ambitie om verder te groeien binnen productmanagement.

 Een starter of circa 1 tot 3 jaar relevante werkervaring, bijvoorbeeld in productmanagement, productmarketing, sales of een vergelijkbare functie.

 Affiniteit met technische producten en commerciële vraagst

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
The challenge 
An entrepreneur chasing an unpaid invoice in Lagos. A shop owner confirming a shipment in Guangzhou. A consultant navigating a bank's phone menu in London. For a growing share of Talk360's 6 million+ users, a call is how they get paid, keep a client or close a deal.
 These business customers choose us because we're cheaper than carrier and roaming rates, reach mobile, landline and company numbers, need no contract, and use one balance for every country. Today we serve them with a consumer app. Tomorrow we want to be the obvious way small businesses call the world.
 
 We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own and scale the Calling for Work product proposition from 1 to 100. There's no mature roadmap to inherit: you'll write it, test it with customers and scale what works, with our Product & Tech team, to deliver a step change in segment growth.
 
 What you’ll do 
 Own the product proposition: Set the vision, strategy, roadmap and targets for Calling for Work, and be responsible for its user growth and retention.

 Shape the business proposition: Define what Talk360's business offer is and how it's priced, together with our commercial teams.

 Learn from customers continuously: Use interviews, surveys, support tickets and app store reviews to turn pains into a ranked opportunity roadmap.

 Experiment fast: Ship small bets, A/B test the journeys that matter, observe real world behaviour and turn results into roadmap decisions.

 Lead delivery: Work in an agile Product & Tech team; keep scope tight, priorities clear and releases flowing.

 AI-native execution: Use AI across discovery, specs, analysis and prototyping, and help shape how the team builds with AI.

 Partner across the business: Work with Revenue, Marketing, Support and Data on go-to-market, acquisition, retention and the metrics that show we're winning.

 
 
 The Team 
 You'll join a lean Product & Engineering team where product, design, mobile, web, backend, VoIP and QA work closely together. No silos, no layers: turn a customer insight on Monday into a live experiment by Friday.
 
 What you’ll bring 
 5+ years in product management, including owning a product line or new proposition end to end.

 A track record of scaling a product from early traction, with commercial results to show.

 Hands-on experience with B2B, SMB or prosumer products; telecoms is a plus.

 Strong discovery skills: customer interviews, research synthesis and jobs-to-be-done thinking.

 Experimentation fluency: A/B testing, product analytics (Mixpanel or similar) and data analysis and data-driven decision making.

 Experience optimising MAU, ARPU, LTV, retention and conversion, with the business acumen to make strategic and tactical calls.

 Experience leading agile, cross-functional mobile product teams, with the technical depth to discuss trade-offs with engineers.

 Active, daily use of AI across your product workflow: research, analysis, specs and prototyping.

 
Who you are 
 Growth mindset: You're energised by building a playbook that doesn't exist yet.

 Ambitious and pragmatic: You aim for 100 but ship the smallest thing that proves the next step.

 Owner: You act without waiting for permission and own outcomes, not output.

 Customer-obsessed: You'd rather talk to five customers than debate one assumption.

 Clear communicator: You align engineers, leadership and partners around one simple story.

 Comfortable with ambiguity: You make good calls on imperfect data and kill what isn't working, even your own ideas.

 You're based in or moving to The Netherlands and can be in our office three days a week.

 
Recruitment process 
 First call: A short intro call with our recruiter.

 Hiring manager interview: A deep dive into your experience with our Head of Product.

 Case study: Present a practical Calling for Work challenge to the team at our office.

 Meet the CEO. 

 Reference check 

 Offer 

 
 What You Get 
 Competitive compensation 
 77,000 - 90,000 euros per year all-in gross

 Learning and growth 
 €1,500 annual personal development budget, plus access to company-wide training sessions to keep learning and evolving. 

 Time to recharge 
 25 vacation days 

 Option to swap two public holidays per year for days that better reflect your culture or beliefs 

 Recharge Fridays, unlocked when team targets are met (we’ll tell you more during the interview) 

 Work from anywhere 
 As a global and diverse team, we encourage you to work from another city or country for up to 2 weeks per year, gain fresh perspectives and spark new ideas. 

 A team you’ll actually want to be part of 
 Weekly team lunch every Thursday 

 Regular team moments and outings 

 An international and diverse team, with colleagues from the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine and beyond 

 Set up for success 
 Company laptop and all the tools you need to do your best work 

 Monthly phone allowance and commuting allowance 

 An environme

jobs.title: Sr Product Manager II
jobs.description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Axon's mission is simple and bold: Protect Life.

We build technology that helps first responders, security teams and communities act with speed, clarity and confidence in the moments that matter most. Our Real-Time Operations (RTO) portfolio, anchored by the Fusus platform, is transforming how law enforcement, enterprise security and international agencies detect, assess and respond to threats.

Fusus connects live video, alerts, sensors and location data into a unified operating picture, and the map is where that picture comes together. It shows where every officer, vehicle, camera, drone and sensor is, what state it is in, and what is happening around it. We're building a map that stays clear under pressure, so operators and responders can see what matters and act in seconds.

Your Impact

As Senior Product Manager for Maps & Presence, you will define and lead the roadmap for how Fusus shows the world in real time. You'll own the live map, floor plans and the presence layer: the "dots on the map" that tell operators who and what is where, and whether that information is fresh.

You'll own the map experience operators use every shift and the map services every other team builds on. Your work will let any device, sensor or data source appear on the map in a consistent way, without bespoke work for each one. That spans body cameras, fleet vehicles, drones, CCTV, sensors and third-party devices, indoors and outdoors.

You'll also lead the map in Axon's next generation of Fusus: role-based experiences built from shared components, where every role gets a map designed for its job. Your work will help responders find the nearest resource, follow an incident as it moves and reconstruct what happened afterwards, directly advancing Axon's mission to Protect Life.

Work Location: This role is based out of our London office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success.

What You'll Do

  • Own the Maps & Presence product roadmap, focused on a map that is clear, consistent and fast to act from
  • Define one behavior model for every real-time dot on the map (how each device type looks, clusters, shows state and freshness) and retire legacy formats
  • Own the map services and contracts (layers, geo-boundaries, floor plans, the Presence API) that let other teams put new data on the map through self-service
  • Build self-service floor plans and map layers for customer admins, so setup no longer depends on Support or Professional Services
  • Lead the map and floor-plan components for Fusus's role-based experiences, shipping them in today's Fusus first
  • Deliver location history (breadcrumbs) and cross-camera tracking for investigations, with Search and video teams
  • Partner with engineering and design to ship responsive, low-latency and reliable map experiences across web and mobile
  • Engage law enforcement and enterprise users in real-time crime centers and the field to validate needs and test improvements
  • Use metrics and feedback to set priorities: dot freshness, map load time, presence coverage, time from alert to action

jobs.title: Product Manager - Business Processes
jobs.description:
Cato Networks is the converged network and security cloud for the AI era. 

As AI reshapes cybersecurity, enterprises face a dual challenge: unlocking AI’s potential while defending against AI-driven attacks. Cato addresses both through a unified, cloud-native platform, providing the visibility and context to prioritize risks and stop threats in real time across users, applications, data, and AI agents. 

Join us as we scale: take on ambitious technological challenges and shape the next generation of enterprise security at a company trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide. 

 

THE OPPORTUNITY

Cato Networks is building Product-Led Growth capabilities that complement its established enterprise, direct-sales, and partner-led business.

We are looking for a hands-on Product Manager to own product-led customer journeys across Cato’s target markets, with a particular focus on SMB while also improving how larger enterprise customers discover, evaluate, activate, adopt, and expand Cato.

For SMB customers, this may include highly self-service journeys from signup and onboarding through value realization, purchase, and expansion. For larger enterprises, PLG will complement the sales-led motion by helping customers experience value sooner, adopt more effectively, identify expansion opportunities, and create stronger product-qualified demand.

This is an individual-contributor role. You will own measurable customer and business outcomes, working directly with Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, Sales, Channel, Customer Success, and Business Operations.

What You’ll Do 

  • Own and improve the end-to-end PLG journey across relevant customer segments: discover → evaluate → activate → experience value → adopt → convert → retain → expand.
  • Define segment-specific product-led journeys for SMB and enterprise customers, balancing self-service, sales-assisted, and partner-assisted experiences.
  • For SMB, drive simple self-service onboarding, guided configuration, sensible defaults, in-product education, packaging, upgrade paths, and purchase experiences.
  • For enterprise customers, identify ways to accelerate evaluation, activation, time-to-value, adoption, product-qualified demand, and expansion.
  • Define the key activation and “aha” moments for different customer segments, and improve time-to-first-value and unassisted or assisted activation.
  • Own product requirements related to trials, free experiences where relevant, packaging, entitlements, upgrade paths, pricing UX, purchase flows, and conversion triggers.
  • Define, instrument, and monitor PLG metrics, including activation, time-to-first-value, product adoption, conversion, product-qualified opportunities, retention, and expansion.
  • Use product analytics, customer research, funnel analysis, and experimentation to identify friction, test hypotheses, and continuously improve outcomes.
  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Channel, Customer Success, Finance, and Business Operations to create seamless product-led, sales-assisted, and partner-assisted journeys.
  • Identify product-usage and behavioral signals that can trigger contextual recommendations, expansion opportunities, partner engagement, or sales outreach. 

What You Bring 

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience in B2B SaaS.

Du erkennst Veränderungen frühzeitig, stellst sie transparent vor und schlägst einen passenden Weg vor: Change Request, Nachbeauftragung oder Re-Priorisierung. 

 Projektcontrolling:  Du verantwortest Budget-Forecast und Abrechnung mit dem Kunden sowie Vorbereitung und Moderation der monatlichen Steering Meetings. 

 Stakeholder Management:  Du bist im Projektalltag die zentrale Ansprechperson für den Kunden und managst Erwartungen, Risiken und Eskalationen 

 AI-basierte Delivery:  Du setzt AI täglich ein, etwa für Anforderungsdokumentation, Meeting-Zusammenfassungen, Status-Reports, Risikoanalysen, Prototypen und Testfälle, und zeigst Team und Kunden, was davon im Projekt wirklich trägt. 

 Account-Entwicklung:  Du erkennst Potenziale für Folgevorhaben und entwickelst den Account auch strategisch weiter. 

 Mitgestalten:  Du prägst mit, wie Projektmanagement in einer AI-first-Organisation aussieht: Prozesse, Templates, Tooling und das Zusammenspiel mit Agentic Engineering. 

 

 Was du mitbringst Erfahrung:  Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Projektmanagement oder als Product Owner in der Softwareentwicklung, davon mehrere Jahre mit Kundenprojekten in einer Digitalagentur, Technologieberatung oder einem Softwareunternehmen. 

 Ownership:  Erfahrung mit Projekten mit festem Scope und festen Terminen und ein sicheres Gespür dafür, wann ein Projekt aus dem Ruder zu laufen beginnt. 

 Requirements:  Die Fähigkeit, Anforderungen so zu formulieren, dass Engineers damit bauen können, und nach Geschäftswert zu priorisieren. 

 Tech-Verständnis:  Ein fundiertes Verständnis moderner Softwareentwicklung, von Architekturen und Schnittstellen über Cloud bis zu agiler Lieferung. Du musst nicht programmieren, aber du verstehst, worüber dein Team spricht. 

 Zahlenverständnis:  Du kalkulierst Budgets, behältst die Marge im Blick und erklärst Forecasts so, dass der Kunde jede Zahl nachvollziehen kann. 

 AI-Praxis:  KI ist für dich selbstverständlich: Du nutzt Assistenten, Agents und Automatisierungstools täglich, baust dir eigene Workflows und weißt aus Erfahrung, wo AI im Projektalltag trägt und wo nicht. 

 Kommunikation:  Die Souveränität, Steering Meetings mit Bereichsleitungen genauso zu moderieren wie Refinements und Workshops mit dem Team. 

 Sprache: Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch (mind. C1). 

 

 Das erwartet dich bei uns Gestaltungsspielraum:  Du prägst mit, wie Projektmanagement bei Turbine aussieht. 

 Kurze Wege:  Du hast einen direkten Draht zur Geschäftsführung und kurze Entscheidungswege. 

 Langfristige Projekte:  Unsere Auftraggeber setzen auf langfristige Zusammenarbeit und erwarten strategische Impulse von dir. 

 Starke Teams:  Du bringst mit erfahrenen Consultants, Engineers, Architekt:innen und den Teams unserer Auftraggeber Projekte sicher ins Ziel bringst. 

 Zwei plus drei:  Hybrides Arbeiten mit zwei Tagen im Office in Berlin und drei Tagen flexibel. 

 Frischer Wind für deine Ideen:  In unseren Breakout- und Hackout-Sessions entwickelst du neue Ideen und testest neue Wege. 

 Meerblick statt Bürowand:  Pack deinen Laptop ein und arbeite eine Zeit lang aus unserer Agentur-Wohnung in Faro, Portugal. 

 Wachse über dich hinaus:  Wir geben dir Zeit und Budget für deine persönliche Weiterbildung. 

 Fit bleiben, wie du willst:  Wir bezuschussen deine Mitgliedschaft im Urban Sports Club
