jobs.title: Product Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
Product Marketing Lead 
 Reporting to: CMO
 Location: London (hybrid, 4 days a week in the office)
 Salary: £80,000-£100,000 + equity
 About Electric Twin 
 Most organisations make their biggest decisions on a thin slice of evidence - a handful of customer calls, one survey, instinct when the data runs out. Electric Twin changes that. We build synthetic audiences: simulations of real groups of people, grounded in research data. Teams ask them questions, test ideas and explore how people might respond, and get answers in minutes that would otherwise take weeks.
 The work is grounded, and the science is real. We've run over 40,000 evaluations across populations covering 155 countries. Independent academic research with Professor Michael Muthukrishna at the LSE found our outputs come back roughly 10,000x faster than traditional methods, at 95% accuracy. Customers including The Times, Sage, Virgin, Vodafone and Wingstop use Electric Twin to bring customer insight into decisions about campaigns, products, pricing and strategy.
 Electric Twin was founded by Dr Ben Warner (former Chief Data Advisor to the UK Prime Minister) and our CEO, Alex Cooper (a former senior military commander and Director of Mass Covid Testing in the pandemic). We're backed by Atomico, LocalGlobe, Mercuri and angels including Marc Andreessen. We're a team of engineers, AI researchers, behavioural scientists and operators - careful with the science, careful with the responsibility.
 The role 
 We're hiring a Product Marketing Lead to own product marketing at Electric Twin, from the strategy through to the sales deck.
 Our ambition is to make understanding people a normal part of making decisions. Product marketing is central to that. It's how we decide who Electric Twin is for, what we compete against and why a buyer should choose us, and how that story reaches the market through our product, our website and our sales team.
 Next year is a big one. We're launching in new markets, taking Electric Twin to more parts of a business, and bringing more products to market. We need someone who has operated at this level before, and who can join the dots between sales, marketing and product.
 Product marketing here covers four areas: insights, storytelling, go-to-market and enablement. You'll own all four, and decide where to lean in as the company grows.
 You'll work closely with our CMO, our VP Product and our sales team. Our Growth Lead runs the engine - the channels and programmes that reach and convert our audience. Product marketing and content provide the fuel. You'll own positioning and messaging. Our Content Lead will turn it into stories and get them out across every channel.
 This is a hands-on role. You'll set the strategy, and you'll also write the launch plan, the value proposition brief and the sales deck yourself.

What’s exciting - you’re the founding PMM and get to build out and lead this function as we expand.
 What you'll do 
 Insights 
 Be the expert on our customer. We have strong customer research, a map of what customers want to use the product for and a regular round-up of the questions they ask. Build on it, keep it current and make sure the rest of the business uses it.

 Understand the buyers we're growing into. Our buyer today is the insights team. Marketing, product and commercial teams come next. Speak to them, define who they are and work out what they need to hear from us.

 Know the market. This is a fast-moving category, with research incumbents launching their own products and a new batch of innovators arriving. Track it, and keep a clear, committed point of view on how Electric Twin is different.

 Bring an opinion to product strategy. Work with our VP Product on the value proposition, and bring the customer and the market into decisions about what we build.

 Storytelling 
 Own our positioning and messaging. Keep one consistent way of describing what Electric Twin is, who it is for and why a buyer should choose it, used by sales, product and marketing.

 Own the trust story. Trust is central to how buyers choose us. Own how we prove it: the evidence, the customer stories and the guidance for prospects who want to evaluate us for themselves.

 Turn the product into language a buyer would use. Take what we build and describe it in the customer's words, across the website, the product and our sales materials.

 Shape the story for new markets and buyers. Build and adjust the narrative for our new market launches, and for the teams beyond insight and research that we want to reach.

 Go-to-market 
 Set the product narrative. Agree a product narrative each quarter with our VP Product, so every launch adds up to a bigger story.

 Run our launches. Build a tiered launch process so the effort matches the size of the release, and run it with product, sales and marketing.

 Take Electric Twin to new buyers and markets. Plan how we go to market in the US, in new verticals and with new teams inside our customers.

 Improve

 Testing and learning with customers: Running customer research and testing ideas to understand what people need, how they behave and what works best.

 Increasing impact with AI: Building tools and automations with AI that save time for you, the ops team and the wider business

 Experience: 1–2 years in product, or 2-3 years in strategy, analytics, consulting or similar roles, ideally with experience working closely with product or delivery teams to get things done.

 Communication: You can clearly explain ideas and requirements to different audiences, from writing specs for engineers to training Operations teams.

 Curiosity: You ask lots of questions and aren't satisfied until you understand why something is happening.

 Problem-solving: You enjoy forming hypotheses and finding the quickest way to test them, even if the first version is rough around the edges.

 Data-driven: You're comfortable working with data and can use SQL or Python to investigate problems and answer your own questions.

 In six years, Lendable has built a profitable, market-leading credit card in the UK. In 2023, we brought that playbook to the US and set an even higher bar. This year the US credit card business scaled rapidly: our run rate grew more than 20x in the last six months.
 A lot of the work of getting customers through the door is in place. The next stage is about what happens once they’re in: helping them pay on time, giving more credit to the ones who earn it, getting people back on track when they fall behind, and ensuring an intuitive user experience across channels.
 If you're excited by fintech, lending and scaling products in a fast-moving environment, this role offers real ownership, impact and room to grow.
 
 About the role 
 We're hiring a Associate Product Manager to join the product team, and will cover post booking areas including payments, collections, credit limit increases, spend, and the mobile app.
 No two weeks look the same. One week you might be sizing an opportunity, the next week sitting with the ops team to understand why customers are calling, or putting a rough version of an idea in front of real customers before anyone builds the proper one. We care more about how quickly we learn than how polished the first attempt looks.
 
 What you'll work on 
 Running experiments across the customer lifecycle, such as how and when we remind people to pay, what gets them to set up autopay, and how we gamify engagement

 Working with credit risk and data science on how to apply models to new use cases and opportunities

 Finding cheap, fast ways to test an idea (a manual process, an email, a script) with AI before committing engineering time to it

 Gathering customer research to get truthful and unbiased reads

 Building tools and automations with AI that save time for you, the ops team and the wider business

 Doing whatever it takes to get something live, including the unglamorous parts like unblocking developers, socializing with legal and compliance, or writing the guide for the ops team
 

 What we're looking for 
 Don’t worry if you don’t meet all these criteria. We'd love to talk to any great candidate that is excited, inquisitive, and a go-getter.
 1-4 years in product, strategy, analytics, consulting or operations, with some time spent working closely to product or execution teams to deliver value

 You ask a lot of questions and you're not satisfied until you understand why something is happening

 You enjoy forming a hypothesis and finding the quickest way to test it, even if the first version is rough

 You're comfortable with data: you can write SQL or Python and answer your own questions

 You're already using AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor or Codex in your work or side projects, and you want to see how far they go

 You're happy to pick up the small jobs, understanding that as a lean product team no job is too unworthy of our attention

 You like days that look different from each other

 Bonus: experience in lending, payments, fintech or a fast-growing startup

 Keep in mind: you will not be a fit for this role if you're looking for a well-defined backlog to manage, or you'd rather wait until a problem is fully specified before starting on it. Much of what we work on starts as a loose question with multiple options possible.
 
 AI at Lendable 
 We want to build the most AI-forward financial services company in the world. PMs here make their own dashboards to answer questions that used to need an analyst, build their own agents and workflows to take care of repetitive work, and ship straightforward changes to product

jobs.title: Lead Product Designer
jobs.description:
Lead Product Designer - Cortex 
 📍 Manchester (Hybrid, up to 4 days WFH) 
 💰 Competitive salary, dependent on experience 
  
 Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to transform the experience of buying, selling, renting and letting property, elevating UK estate agencies through world-class technology.
  
 Cortex is an exciting new product that brings agentic AI into Street and Spectre, taking on the busywork so agents can focus on winning instructions and building relationships. It's early, moving fast, and will ultimately touch every part of the product suite. We're looking for a Lead Product Designer to shape what agentic UX looks like across all of it.
  
 We want someone who is genuinely excited by agentic AI, past needing to be told what's worth working on, and ready to help define a product category that doesn't have a playbook yet - working closely with senior stakeholders across the business.
  
 If you look at most UX job ads, you see a laundry list of requirements. We prefer to tell you how we actually operate so you can decide if this is the right environment for you.
 At Street Group, design is a strategic seat. You'll drive direction alongside product and engineering, not respond to them.

 Our users rely on us to run their businesses, so they love talking to us. You can spin up a call and validate a prototype instantly. We don't guess; we ask.

 We move at pace, including on strategic work. Strategy isn't a separate, slower track here - we test it by shipping.

  
 Here's what you can expect to be working on 
 Shape the UX of agentic AI across Street and Spectre - deciding which agency workflows agents should own, then designing how that actually feels and builds trust for the user.

 Design across the whole suite, not one domain - valuation, prospecting, marketing, enquiry handling, sales progression, property management. You'll hold a huge amount of context.

 Define the patterns for a new category. There's no established playbook for agentic UX in property - you'll set it.

 Set the craft bar through your own output. The work you ship is the reference point for what good looks like.

 Prototype, test and ship at pace - getting working prototypes in front of real agents and iterating fast.

  
 You should apply if: 
 You’re curious about how AI is changing product design and you already use it in your own work. You’re comfortable designing features that use it, without needing deep specialist experience.

 You’ve got a well-formed point of view on building trust into a product - how you design for transparency and control, how you handle edge cases and errors, and how you make sure users always feel in charge.

 You stay current. This field moves monthly and you keep on top of it.

 You're energised by an undefined problem space and bring the case for what's worth doing, rather than waiting for a brief.

 You're commercially fluent - you make design trade-offs informed by how the product performs, not just user preference. You define success before you ship and read the result after.

  
 You probably shouldn't apply if: 
 Your AI experience is limited to speeding up your own workflow. This role is about designing AI into the product, and that gap will show quickly.

 You're looking for the next pay band up from Senior with broadly similar expectations. This is not a "Senior+" role - it expects materially more scope, autonomy and judgment.

 You need a well-defined problem before you can start. Cortex is still taking shape, and that won't change soon.

 You expect to be handed a roadmap. Here, you help write it.

  
 A bit about you 
 Complex product experience:: Complex product experience: You’ve designed for complex, data-heavy or technical products, with real examples of how you made them simple and trustworthy for users.

 Craft: Lead-level UX and product design. Your work is exemplary and you can articulate it clearly enough to teach.

 Breadth: Comfortable operating across the whole product suite and holding a lot of context at once, not going deep on a single domain.

 Ambiguity: You do your best work when the problem isn't yet defined.

 Cross-functional: A peer at the table with product and engineering, partnering closely with a good PM without treading on each other's toes.

 Technical fluency: Being hands-on enough to prototype with code is a real advantage here, given how close design sits to how these systems work. It's a plus, not a hard requirement.

 Experience: Typically this comes with around 8+ years in product/UX design at senior IC level - but we care more about evidence you can operate at Lead altitude than the exact number, especially given how new agentic AI is. SaaS or complex product experience is helpful; property experience isn't required.

jobs.title: (Senior) Product Manager | Full Time (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Who Are We ? 
 🚧 Picture logistics that run like clockwork – fast, smart, and seamless. 
 Autonomous logistics does not start with self-driving trucks. It starts with CONROO.
 At CONROO, we are building an intelligent infrastructure that drives terminals and depots towards autonomy by connecting truck drivers, terminals, and depots through continuous data flows. We replace manual and paper-based processes with real-time, data-driven workflows, turning chaos into connected systems and making truck handling fully digital.
 Every step we automate today lays the foundation for terminals and depots to operate autonomously tomorrow.
 We are CONROO and we are driving logistics to autonomy. 
 💼 About This Role 
 As a (Senior) Product Manager at CONROO, you'll be one of the people steering where our product goes next. You'll spend time with customers and stakeholders to really understand what they need, then turn that into requirements the team can actually build from. You'll work closely with our developers day to day, answering questions, and making calls when priorities need to shift. It’s a role with real ownership, where your decisions matter and you can see their impact directly in the product.
 🎖 What Success Looks Like 
 In your first month 
 You become familiar with the company, product, development process, customers, and key business areas and projects.

 You work closely with Tech, Sales, and other teams to understand customer needs, business objectives, and product priorities.

 You join Scrum ceremonies and observe how requirements and priorities are managed.

 You align and guide a cross-functional team. Setting clear priorities, offering direction, and helping people do their best work.

 By 3 months 
 You analyse and manage project requirements and stakeholder demands.

 You independently create, prioritize, and maintain the product backlog based on customer needs and business objectives.

 You take ownership of user stories, acceptance criteria, and product requirements.

 You take an active role in Scrum management and coordination.

 You work with the relevant team members to ensure our product meets UX standards, quality standards, and relevant regulatory requirements.

 You will communicate product vision, goals, priorities, and progress to internal and external stakeholders.

 You communicate directly with customers and stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into actionable requirements.

 You will have ownership of assigned projects and topics and manage them with increasing autonomy.

 By 6 months 
 You independently manage projects and requirements from initial stage through implementation.

 You have ownership of Scrum processes and ensure effective collaboration and communication across teams.

 You proactively identify customer needs, product opportunities, risks, and areas for improvement.

 You contribute significantly to product development and prioritisation.

 You consistently improve project management, requirements management, and quality processes where needed.

 You operate autonomously while keeping relevant stakeholders aligned and informed.

 You become the trusted point of contact for product-related topics across Tech, Sales, and other teams.

 🚀 What You Need to Be Successful 
 You have a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Business Informatics, Information Technology, or a related field.

 You bring several years of experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager, ideally in a SaaS environment.

 You have experience working with SCRUM and agile development processes.

 You have experience in specifying requirements and developing user and technical stories.

 You possess a solid understanding of technology, software development, and digital products.

 You quickly grasp complex processes & technical requirements allowing you to create tailored solutions that deliver value for both clients and the business.

 You bring strong communication skills and are confident working with a wide range of stakeholders, from C-level executives and internal teams to customers.

 You bring strong organizational skills and are comfortable managing and prioritizing multiple requirements.

 You are fluent in German and English, both written and spoken.

 This role is based in our Munich or Nuremberg office, with at least 3 days per week on site.
 ⚙️ Must Have Tools & Technologies 
 You have experience working with Jira or similar project management tools.

 You are familiar with Figma or similar design and collaboration tools.

 You have experience working with CRM systems.

 💡It’s a Plus If You Have 
 Previous experience in the logistics industry.

 Experience working in a startup or scale-up environment.

 🌟 How We Set You Up to Be Successful 
 At CONROO, we don’t just define what success looks like – we actively support you in getting there through a structured, hands-on onboarding process during your first six months with us. 
 Onboar

jobs.title: Product Manager, Finance Engineering
jobs.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us to redefine the future of on-demand delivery. To do this, we're building a world-class Finance Engineering (FinEng) organization across all global markets we support at DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt. in which each of our product managers plays a critical role in helping to define and execute our vision to move money accurately and at scale across every market we operate in and ensure finance and accounting compliance. As we grow, billions of dollars in money movements flow through our platform every year and our team makes sure every one of them is understood, trusted, and correctly reflected in the financial books.

About the Role

Product Managers on the Finance Engineering team need a systems-oriented mindset, platform thinking, and strong cross-functional collaboration. In this role, you will define the strategy and vision for systems that track billions of dollars in company-wide money movement, translate transactions into accounting entries, and accelerate the financial close. You will build scalable, audit-ready automation for complex, high-volume financial activity.

This is an opportunity to reshape modern accounting by applying AI to reconciliation, investigations, and incident detection and mitigation. Your products will form a critical part of the company’s financial infrastructure and help earn the confidence of leadership, auditors, and regulators.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Drive the product definition, strategy, and long-term vision for accounting automation. You own the roadmap
  • Build systems that track billion-dollar-level money movements across the entire company and automatically convert them into accurate accounting entries
  • Reinvent and accelerate the accounting close process, reducing manual effort and shortening close timelines
  • Champion AI-driven approaches to transform close reconciliation, financial investigations, and incident detection and mitigation
  • Partner with FinEng, Accounting, and Finance leaders to translate complex financial and regulatory requirements into scalable, automated products
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams of engineers, designers, data scientists, accountants, and operators
  • Communicate product plans, benefits, and results to key stakeholders including the leadership team

We're excited about you because…

  • You have a track record in product management, including driving product strategy, vision, and roadmap alignment
  • You have built complex, back-end, data-intensive, or platform products. Ideally in fintech, payments, accounting, or financial systems
  • You have a strong grasp of accounting concepts (e.g. double-entry, ledgers, reconciliations, the close process) and how financial data flows through complex system
  • You do your best work with range: global platform thinking alongside the accounting reality of a specific brand or market
  • You're an execution power-house who thrives in ambiguity and operates at the lowest level of detai
  • You are excited about applying AI/ML to real-world financial problems such as reconciliation, investigation, and incident mitigation
  • You have experience presenting business reviews to senior executives
  • You have empathy for the users you build for, including accountants, controllers, and finance operators
  • You are motivated by building financial infrastructure that works across DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning. 💰 Share in the success you help create Competitive salary and equity options, so you’re rewarded for the impact you make.

➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog. We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—ou

Most recently publishing breakout hits such as The Precinct and Town to City. It’s a unique chance to bring your expertise to a global studio that dominates both the mobile, and the indie PC and Console space.

 

 At Kwalee, as well as a competitive salary we also offer; Private Medical Insurance, Dental Insurance, Life Assurance, Royal London Pension, a Free On-site Gym, Dog-friendly Office, LinkedIn Learning, 25 holiday days + bank holidays, and 1 day extra holiday for each year of service capped at 5.

 Kwalee’s Product & Growth team is looking for a Senior Product Manager to shape what comes next in our live games: what we change, why, and what it will earn.

 Great product decisions and the extra player value that they will create in our biggest games.

 You’ll be the champion who ensures every big player opportunity gets a smart hypothesis, a clear experiment, and a place on the roadmap.

 Growth in LTV and profit from product changes.

 Retention, engagement, and monetisation in your games.

 Experiments launched, learned from, and shipped.

 Clear, well-reasoned roadmap decisions.

 A clear, warm communicator who makes the case to players and pounds.

 SQL experience.

 Experience guiding or mentoring analysts.

 Puzzle or hybrid-casual mobile game experience.

jobs.title: Product Manager - UX/UI Focus (AI x Greentech) (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
As a AI Product Manager at Reonic , you’ll own product problems from discovery through execution.
 You’ll work closely with customers, product, design, and engineering to understand what users need, define the right solutions, and bring them to life. A strong focus of your role will be shaping the UX and UI of our product — from improving existing workflows to designing entirely new experiences.
 You’ll combine product thinking with a strong eye for design, constantly asking: What problem are we solving, for whom, and how can we make the experience as simple and valuable as possible? 
 You’ll have significant ownership and the opportunity to directly shape how the product looks, feels, and works.
 Please note: This is a fully onsite role in Augsburg. 
 
 What you'll do 
 Own product problems end-to-end: Take ownership of product areas from discovery and problem definition through prioritization, design, development, launch, and iteration.

 Shape the user experience: Design intuitive, efficient, and delightful experiences across the product. Turn complex workflows into simple solutions that users can understand and adopt quickly.

 Understand our users: Talk to customers, analyze feedback and usage data, identify pain points, and develop a deep understanding of how renewable installers work.

 Think beyond the brief: Challenge assumptions, identify opportunities, and make sure we’re solving the right problem rather than simply building what was initially requested.

 Design and prototype: Work hands-on with wireframes, prototypes, and UI concepts to explore solutions quickly. Iterate with users and the team before investing heavily in development.

 Set the UX/UI bar: Maintain a high standard for usability, consistency, accessibility, and visual quality across the product.

 Balance user and business needs: Make thoughtful product trade-offs based on customer value, business impact, technical feasibility, and available data.

 Work closely with engineering: Collaborate with engineers throughout the product development process, communicate requirements clearly, and make pragmatic decisions when trade-offs arise.

 Iterate after launch: Treat shipping as the beginning, not the end. Measure outcomes, collect feedback, identify opportunities, and continuously improve the product experience.

 Leverage AI in your workflow: Use AI tools to accelerate research, ideation, prototyping, analysis, and product development.

 
 What Makes You a Great Fit 
 Product experience: 2+ years of experience in product management, product design, UX/UI, or a similar product-focused role, ideally in a startup or fast-growing product environment.

jobs.description:
Build something monumental for Healthcare!

 
 At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.
 We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!
 
 About the Role 
 You care about making complex systems actually work, not just in theory, but in practice - across teams, stakeholders, and real-world constraints. In previous roles, you were likely the person who brought clarity to messy situations: aligning engineers, partners, and product teams to get things shipped.

At Tandem, you'll drive how our platform connects with the external systems used across French and European healthcare - owning and driving some of the most critical technical initiatives we have. You'll be based in our France office, working alongside the local team, in close collaboration with our central Integrations team in Stockholm. A big part of the role is deeply understanding both sides: the capabilities and constraints of external systems, and those of our own platform. From that understanding, you'll find ways to integrate them and shape concrete proposals for how integrations should work, together with external partners.

You move fast, but not carelessly. You know how to break down complex problems, prioritize what matters, and keep momentum across multiple workstreams. You're comfortable going deep technically when needed, understanding APIs, data flows, and system constraints, while still keeping the bigger product picture in mind.
 
This is a high-impact role where you'll not only deliver projects, but shape how we build and scale technical products at Tandem.
 
 What You'll Do 
 Lead integration work with external partners and healthcare systems, ensuring high-quality, scalable implementations.

 Map external systems against our own platform and propose concrete integration designs to external partners.

 Act as the central point of coordination between engineering, partnerships, and external stakeholders, bridging the local team in France and the integrations team in Stockholm.

 Translate complex technical requirements into clear priorities, plans, and deliverables.

 Work closely with engineers to understand APIs, data models, and system architecture, and ensure solutions are robust and aligned with our platform.

 Identify bottlenecks, manage dependencies, and keep projects moving at high velocity.

 Build and improve how we work - establishing processes, templates, and frameworks for integrations and technical delivery.

 Ensure strong visibility across stakeholders - tracking progress, surfacing risks, and communicating clearly.

 Support our sales organisation in answering technical questions from our customers.
 

 What You Bring 
 Experience as a Technical Project Manager or similar role in a SaaS, platform, or healthtech environment.

 Strong ability to drive complex, cross-functional initiatives involving both internal teams and external stakeholders.

 Technical fluency - comfortable discussing APIs, authentication, integrations, and system design with engineers.

 Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams without losing clarity or momentum.

 Ability to anticipate, assess, and manage risk in projects, from scoping through to delivery.

 Strong communication skills, you can translate technical complexity into clear decisions and direction.

 A product mindset - you care about building the right thing, not just delivering on time.

 Native level french speaking.

 Bonus Points 
 Experience in tech sales, enterprise sales, or enterprise software delivery

 Experience working with healthcare systems or regulated environments

 Familiarity with FHIR, HL7, or other healthcare data standards

 Experience working with platform or API products

 Some hands-on technical experience (e.g. scripting, debugging, light coding)

 Experience scaling integration processes or working with multiple external partners

 
 Location 
 We believe the best ideas happen when we're together. This role is based in our Paris office, where you will work primarily on-site with the local team, while collaborating closely with colleagues at our HQ in Stockholm.
 
 How to Apply 
 We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.

Our interview process consists of 4 stages:
 Screening interview with Talent Acquisition

 Technical interview with some of our Engineering team

 Follow-up interview with one of our Team Leads

 Home case and presentation at our Paris office - Join us for a lunch, a discovery meeting and a presentation to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate
